programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы.
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям. (Сімейні мелодрами).

programme.title: Shoreditch.
programme.desc: In London 1939, before the beginning of the Second World War, Thomas and his wife Massie run the Say When jazz club. But when he starts having an affair with singer Butterfly, their world disintegrates into blackmail, drugs, and suicide. (Shoreditch). [16+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Mistika.

programme.title: Modigliani.
programme.desc: American drama, produced in 2004. An American, French, German, Italian, Rumanian, and British co-production. The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne. (Modigliani). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Caesar.
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius. (Julius Caesar). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Caesar.
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius. (Julius Caesar). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Edith.
programme.desc: After the death of his wife Edith, Jake feels like he has lost the chance to confront his past. He is convinced that Edith is haunting him for having lived a lie and for having never challenged her about the legitimacy of their son. "Edith" explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for. (Edith). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Treasure Island.
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime. (Treasure Island). [7+]. Nuotykių.

programme.title: True Smile.
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life. (La sonrisa verdadera). Nuotykių. Biografija.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman.
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus). (I Could Never Be Your Woman). [16+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Rat Race.
programme.desc: Donald P. Sinclair has placed six separate gold coins in different slot machines in his casino. The lucky six who find these coins discover an opportunity of a lifetime. The chance to own $2 million. Locked up in a locker in New Mexico, these six contestants must now race each other, to be the first to the cash. There are no rules in place and everything that could possibly happen, does. Whilst, behind the scenes, Sinclair's associates are placing their bets. (Rat Race). Komedijos. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers.
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers. (Tie dao fei hu). [12+]. Nuotykių. Veiksmo. Komedijos.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido.
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported. (Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun.
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits. (The Old Man & the Gun). [7+]. Kriminalai. Romantiniai. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: That Trip We Took with Dad.
programme.desc: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home? (Die Reise mit Vater). [16+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Zodiac.
programme.desc: THE ZODIAC takes a different look at the famous Zodiac Killer case from other screen treatments of the murders. More than a simple crime story, the film is an emotional thriller focusing on the murders' impact on victims, their families and the wider community. The film follows a police detective and his son who become obsessed with the murders and endanger their family in the process. (The Zodiac). [18+]. Dramos. Kriminalai. Siaubo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Remembrance.
programme.desc: Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again. (Remembrance). [16+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Flock.
programme.desc: This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating. (The Flock). [18+]. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Mistika. Dramos.

programme.title: Harb Karmouz.
programme.desc: General Yousef al-Masri is a well-respected member of the police, living in Karamouz neighbourhood in Alexandria. When a girl raped by British soldiers comes to his station, he is determined to protect her. After he puts the soldier they arrested in custody, hell breaks loose and we witness a one man's fight against an entire army. The story takes place during the reign of King Farouk prior to the 1952 revolution in the English occupation of Egypt. (Karmouz War). [16+]. Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern.
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival. (A berni követ). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles.
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life. (On Wings of Eagles). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical.
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way. (Score: A Hockey Musical). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Jungle Boy.
programme.desc: In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher. (Jungle Boy). Fantastiniai. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding.
programme.desc: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C (The Prince & Me II: The Royal Wedding). [7+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Talea.
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter. (Talea). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Foolproof.
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds. (Foolproof). [16+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Komedijos.

programme.title: Irish Jam.
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money? (Irish Jam). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: North & South: The Battle of New Market.
programme.desc: Based on a true story of the American Civil War, culminating at the Battle of New Market, May 1864. A group of teenage cadets sheltered from war at the Virginia Military Institute must confront the horrors of an adult world when they are called upon to defend the Shenandoah Valley. Leaving behind their youth, these cadets must decide what they are fighting for. (Field Of Lost Shoes). [12+]. Veiksmo. Dramos.

Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun.
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits. (The Old Man & the Gun). [7+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Kriminalai. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers.
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers. (Tie dao fei hu). [12+]. Komedijos. Veiksmo. Nuotykių.

In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood! (My Dad's Christmas Date). [7+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles.
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life. (On Wings of Eagles). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: First Kill.
programme.desc: Wall Street broker Will Beeman (Hayden Christensen) has been struggling with being present for his wife Laura (Megan Leonard) and son Danny (Ty Shelton). Shortly after hearing of Danny being bullied at school, Will decides to take his family to his hometown, Granville, Ohio in order to bond with Danny. Upon entering Granville, Will is reacquainted with Police Chief Marvin Howell (Bruce Willis), a family friend who at one point dated his aunt, Dottie (Deb G. Girdler). Howell advises Will on taking precaution after informing him of a recent bank robbery. While teaching Danny how to hunt with a rifle, Will and Danny witness a heated exchange between two men, one of them holding the other at gunpoint. The unarmed man (Gethin Anthony) is shot in the shoulder after throwing a key near Will's position at a shooting station, attracting the gunman's attention. The gunman opens fire on Will, prompting Will to shoot him with his hunting rifle in self-defense. Upon inspecting the gunman, discovers that the gunman was a police officer who failed to identify himself. Distraught, Will brings the wounded man to the family cabin in order for Laura, a hospital nurse, to provide first aid. (First Kill). [16+]. Dramos. Trileriai. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Max Cloud.
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD. (Max Cloud). [12+]. Veiksmo. Komedijos.

programme.title: Battle of the Damned.
programme.desc: A group of Mercenary led by Maj. Max Gatling are fleeing from a failed rescue attempt, having been hired by a rich industrialist to enter a zombie-infested city to rescue his daughter Jude. At the extraction point, Gatling tells the other survivor he is staying to find Jude and complete the mission. He eventually locates Jude and tells her he is going to get her out of the city, and she takes him to other survivors. There, he is introduced to the survivors including group leader Duke, Reese, Elvis, Lynn, and Anna. Jude is revealed to be in a relationship with Reese and pregnant with his child. The next day when Gatling, Jude, and the others go out to retrieve gasoline from a gas station, Gatling attempts to get Jude out of the city by force when she refuses to go without the others. However, he is stopped by the others and left for dead. After discovering Jude is pregnant, Reese rushes to Gatling's aid so that Jude can be taken out of the city. At this point it is revealed that not only is Jude's father some rich industrialist, but he is also the one who caused the zombie pandemic. While returning to the stronghold to get Jude, Gatling and Reese discover a band of prototype non-programmed robots. Gatling reprograms the robots and proceeds to the stronghold. When it is revealed that the city is to be Firebombing, Gatling and all of the survivors make preparations to escape. (Battle of the Damned). [16+]. Trileriai. Siaubo. Nuotykių. Veiksmo.

programme.desc: Jack is a wanderer whose aimless roaming leads him to a number of interesting locations and into the company of many interesting people, and despite his fascination with bullfighting he leads a largely peaceful existence. When a crime boss' daughter is accidentally gored to death, Jack is implicated in the unfortunate event and singled out for termination by a seemingly unending army of lethal hitmen. As Jack wages an uphill battle for survival against the harsh desert terrain and a hail of gun smoke and lead, his will to live depends on his ability to exercise his demons and come to terms with the fact that he may not live to see another sunrise. (Bullfighter). [16+]. Nuotykių. Fantastiniai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Foolproof.

They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds. (Foolproof). [16+]. Veiksmo. Komedijos. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Departure.
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot. (Departure). [7+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Cookies Fortune.
programme.desc: Cookie's Fortune unfolds over an eventful Easter weekend in the small town of Holly Springs, Mississippi. The town residents are peaceful, kind folk--with the exception of Camille Dixon (Glenn Close) - a pushy theatre director with an incredibly shy younger sister, Cora (Julianne Moore), whose estranged daughter Emma (Liv Tyler) has just returned to town. On the heels of her latest play, Camille is shocked to discover that her Aunt Jewel Mae "Cookie" Orcutt (Patricia Neal) has committed suicide. Terrified at the thought of how this will tarnish the family name, she eats the suicide note to make it look like a burglary. This set-up leads the police to one main suspect, Willis Richland (Charles S. Dutton), who also happens to be Cookie's best friend. Although the rest of the town is convinced Willis didn't commit the crime, an outside investigator (Courtney B. Vance) isn't so sure. As Easter Sunday and opening night of the play arrive, the truth comes out, revealing more secrets than anyone could have possibly imagined. (Cookie's Fortune). Dramos. Komedijos.

His cell is a lavish private room built specifically for him, inaccessible to most in the depths of the prison structure. Even the warden fears venturing into his area of the prison. However, even surrounded by his loyal henchmen and guards in his sectioned off fortress, Balam doesn't know Jack is coming for him to avenge his family, who Balam murdered in cold blood. Balam is tough... but Jack is tougher. (Riot). [16+]. Veiksmo. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Trigger.
programme.desc: Vicki compares the new Peugeot 207 GTi against a classic Peugeot 205 GTi to see if it really does live up to the old car. Jonny road tests the new £350,000, 207mph Mercedes-Benz McLaren SLR Roadster. Tiff and Jason put the Audi R8 and the Porsche 911 Carrera 4S head-to-head. Fifth Gear meets up with Paddy McGuinness once again as he prepares for and takes his motorcycle test. Man looks at what happens when a big, 15 year old Volvo 940 estate crashes into a small, light, 3 year old Renault Modus which has a 5 star Euro NCAP safety rating. (Trigger). [16+]. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Irish Jam.
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money? (Irish Jam). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Treasure Island.
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime. (Treasure Island). [7+]. Nuotykių.

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman.
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus). (I Could Never Be Your Woman). [16+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn.
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it? (Nico the Unicorn). Nuotykių. Fantastiniai.

programme.title: Decembers.
programme.desc: Diciembres centres on the US invasion of Panama in 1989 and a reconciliation among survivors a decade later. Ten years after the brief but brutal US military invasion of Panama on December 20th, 1989, three estranged survivors are nudged towards an intimate reconciliation by the person they lost in common that ruthless night. (Diciembres). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Wings Of Eagles.
programme.desc: The continuing true story of Eric Liddell's glorious life after winning Olympic gold in the 1924 Paris Olympics. Liddell has returned to China, where he was born to missionary parents, modestly avoiding celebrity in order to teach local schoolchildren. In 1937, the Japanese invade China at the outset of WWll. Liddell with his friend Xu Niu, a street smart resistance fighter, recognize the increasing danger so Liddell sends his wife, Florence and their two daughters to safety in Canada. Duty-bound, Liddell stays to minister to the civilian victims. Liddell and other foreign nationals are taken as prisoners and placed in one of the many Japanese internment camps where they are forced to endure for two years. Before the Japanese surrender, Liddell succumbs to a brain tumor. Yet his message of hope became immortal. Eric Liddell's legacy continues to this day as he remains admired as a champion for life. (On Wings of Eagles). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Caesar.
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius. (Julius Caesar). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Caesar.
programme.desc: Epic look at Julius Caesar, Rome's last dictator, whose death also signaled the end of the Roman Republic. Chronicles his campaigns in Gaul and Egypt, his rivalry with General Pompey, and his eventual assassination at the hands of Brutus and Cassius. (Julius Caesar). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Foolproof.
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds. (Foolproof). [16+]. Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Komedijos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Talea.
programme.desc: Summertime. Everybody is excited to go on vacation to Italy. Everybody but Jasmin. Jasmin is yearning something. She wants to be with Eva, her mother, from whom she had to live seperately for a long time. For weeks, Jasmin is trying to get close to Eva. She does not give up, even if she's rejected. After an argument, Jasmin runs away from her fosterhome and convinces Eva to leave the city together and go on a trip. The two get closer -- sometimes as friends, sometimes as mother and daughter. A first joint cigarette, a dance in the village disco, wanderings through the woods. But expectations and needs of the girl and her mother are diverging repeatedly, especially when a man attracts Eva's attention and disturbs the growing closeness between mother and daughter. (Talea). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: She's No Angel.
programme.desc: A pregnant woman fleeing a violent boyfriend, boards a train and is taken into care by a newlywed couple. The train crashes, the couple are killed and the girl is taken for the dead newlywed wife because she was wearing her ring at the time the crash happened. (She's No Angel). [12+]. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: True Justice.
programme.desc: Kane and his team track two suitcase nukes that have been smuggled into the country – and Kane thinks the Ghost is working to buy them. As Kane gets ever-closer to The Ghost, he lets Finch go into the field…but is she willing to do whatever it takes? (True Justice). [18+]. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Dramos.

programme.title: Black Cop.
programme.desc: A black police officer gets pushed to the edge after he is profiled and assaulted by the colleagues he worked side by side with, so he decides to get revenge and take his frustrations out on the community that he swore to protect. (Black Cop). [16+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done.
programme.desc: The film begins with Detective Havenhurst driving with his partner Detective Vargas. They receive a call and drive to the scene of a murder. As they push their way through the crowd at the crime scene, they see Brad McCullam leaving with a coffee cup. Inside the house, the detectives find the body of Mrs. McCullam, Brad's mother, who has just been stabbed with an antique sword. At the scene are the neighbors and chief witnesses, Mrs. and Miss Roberts. The detectives soon realize that they had just seen the murderer leaving the scene. (My Son, My Son, What Have Ye Done). [16+]. Dramos. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Rules of Engagement.
programme.desc: In 1968, a disastrous American advance in the Vietnam War has Lieutenant Terry Childers executing an unarmed prisoner in order to intimidate a captive Vietnam People's Army officer into calling off an ambush of United States Marine Corps. His act thereby saves the life of the wounded Lieutenant Hayes Hodges though many of Hodges' men die in the battle. (Rules of Engagement). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions.
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation. (Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions). [12+].

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date.
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood! (My Dad's Christmas Date). [7+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Altitude.
programme.desc: Action movie. American action, produced in 2017. FBI agent Gretchen Blair receives a strange offer from a fellow passenger regarding an impending hijacking. She soon finds herself trapped in a mid-air heist, fighting to protect everyone on board. (Altitude). [12+]. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Almost Friends.
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way. (Almost Friends). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Owd Bob.
programme.desc: A teen orphan spends the summer on Isle of Man with estranged grandpa. Despite loving dogs, they want summer to end. Boy befriends neighbor girl, but her father has history with grandpa. Locals suspect neighbor's dog kills sheep at night. (Old Bob). Dramos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido.
programme.desc: An Italian immigrant is thrust into the world of drug-lords, supercars and secret agents in this hilarious action comedy. After losing his job at the Disco Valet Company for undue heroism, Guido (Silvio Pollio) must pose as a Sicilian gangster for the FBI in order to infiltrate a powerful Asian gang. Things go sour and take a turn for the worse. Guido must now make amends before he is discovered and killed, or worse, deported. (Guido Superstar: The Rise of Guido). [12+]. Komedijos.

programme.title: Lost in Florence.
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police. (Lost in Florence). [12+]. Nuotykių. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: True Smile.
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life. (La sonrisa verdadera). Nuotykių. Biografija.

programme.title: The Ambassador to Bern.
programme.desc: Attila Szasz's political thriller portraying the events of the hostage taking of the Hungarian ambassador to Switzerland in the aftermath of the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. The film was presented at numerous festivals all over the world. It won the Frederico Fellini Award at Tiburon International Film Festival. (A berni követ). [12+]. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Departure.
programme.desc: Two broken souls meet by chance on countryside. A man and a woman, neither of them young anymore, both saddled with the great disappointments. They understand one another, even without need of many words, each providing the other with support and solace for this brief section of life's journey which they share. Cinema has taken many different roads to tell stories of despair, pain, grief and loneliness. Yet this film forges its own unique path. It leads from an abandoned carpenter's workshop via a run-down old house to a port. The pace is sedate, the whole area deserted. A bottle of schnapps, a bouquet of gladioli, a few apples and potatoes, a photograph, a suitcase and a book of Russian poems - these are the only props needed for the minimalist plot. (Departure). [7+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog.
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family. (Timber the Treasure Dog). Veiksmo. Komedijos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Supercon.
programme.desc: This episode revolved around the fading popularity of local ice cream vans. The subject of the documentary is Mr Softytop, a grumpy ice-cream man who verbally assaults his customers and Darren, his assistant. His attempts to boost sales include inventing the "Millennium Cone", selling at the site of road accidents and renting pornography, films include: Shaving Private Ryan, Beverly Hills Cock, Look Who's Porkin and the Phantom Penis. (A real sex shop in Bolton is called Softy's Hard Stuff). To make matters worse he has to compete with a new competitor, Signór Wippy. (Supercon). [16+]. Veiksmo. Komedijos.

programme.title: True Justice.
programme.desc: Kane continues to track the suitcase nukes, but now suspects that his contact inside the CIA may be working against him. Kane knows he's running out of time and teams up with an old friend to stop the suitcase nukes from reaching their prospective buyers. Kane knows The Ghost is now closer than ever…Kane and his team have removed The Ghost's support systems but fall under attack when they try to secure the suitcase nukes. (True Justice). [16+]. Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Fighting Season.
programme.desc: On the brink of the 2007 U.S. troop surge, two Army Recruiters face the daunting pressures of recruitment while their own deployment is on the line. Sgt. Harris has been stationed in the recruiting office long enough for it to feel like home. On the other side of the world, a roadside bomb rips through a Humvee, and after recovering from the attack, Sgt. Mason gets reassigned and winds up in Harris's office. Mason wants to go back to the front lines, but he finds out that the war isn't confined to the battlefield. (A Fighting Season). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Weaponized.
programme.desc: A damaged homicide detective (Johnny Messner) must prevent a grieving father from unleashing a "robotic virus" that he believes will destroy the terrorist cell that murdered his son, but at an unimaginable cost. (Weaponized). [16+]. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Ką rodo "Filmzone"?.
programme.desc: (What's on Filmzone?).

programme.title: Juodoji gulbė.
programme.desc: Nina - jauna ir talentinga balerina, visiškai atidavusi save baletui. Mergina gyvena su mama Erica, kuri kontroliuoja kiekvieną merginos žingsnį ir reikalauja maksimaliai gerai ir meistriškai šokti ir pasiekti balerinos karjeros viršūnę. Savaime suprantama, Nina niekada neturėjo jokio asmeninio gyvenimo. Teatre baletmeisteris Thomas Leroy kuria naują "Gulbių ežero" versiją. Pagrindinio vaidmens atlikėja keičiama jaunesne ir talentingesne. Kanditatė į jos vietą - Nina, turėsianti suvaidinti baltąją ir juodąją gulbes, įkūnijančias nekaltumą ir aistrą, šviesiąją ir tamsiąją asmenybės puses. Mergina idealiai atitinka visus pagrindinio vaidmens atlikėjai keliamus reikalavimus. Tačiau ar sugebės tyra ir švelni Nina įtikanamai suvaidinti aistringą ir pagiežingą juodąją gulbę? (Black Swan). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Vėjavaikė.
programme.desc: Keli puslapiai iš 30-metės Popės gyvenimo, per kurį ji eina juokdamasi. Valiūkiškai suvaldo jaunesnius moksleivius darbe, nebijo išmokti naujų dalykų ir lengvai užmezga pokalbį net su nepažįstamais žmonėmis... (Happy-Go-Lucky). Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Mano pusseserė Reičel.
programme.desc: Jaunas anglas Filipas atvykęs į Florenciją sužino, kad mirė jo pusbrolis Ambrozijus. Dėl ankstyvos giminaičio mirties jis kaltina Ambrozijaus našlę Reičel ir prisiekia jai atkeršyti. (My Cousin Rachel). [12+]. Trileriai. Mistika. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.desc: Nina - jauna ir talentinga balerina, visiškai atidavusi save baletui. programme.desc: Keli puslapiai iš 30-metės Popės gyvenimo, per kurį ji eina juokdamasi. Valiūkiškai suvaldo jaunesnius moksleivius darbe, nebijo išmokti naujų dalykų ir lengvai užmezga pokalbį net su nepažįstamais žmonėmis... (Happy-Go-Lucky). Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Tambldaunas.
programme.desc: Hana sunkiai išgyvena mylimo vyro ir garsaus dainininko netektį. Tačiau netikėtai ji susiduria su rašytoju iš Niujorko, siekiančiu sužinoti daugiau apie jos vyrą bei jo mirties aplinkybes. Būdami nepaprastai skirtingi jie imasi kartu rašyti biografiją ir tuo pačiu kurti savąją. Atsiverskite savo naujo gyvenimo puslapį. Kartais žmogus, iš kurio mažiausiai tikiesi, yra tas, kurio labiausiai tau reikia. Rebecca Hall ir Džeisonas Sudeikis romantinėje istorijoje – "Tambldaunas". (Tumbledown). Muzikiniai. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Žalioji knyga.
programme.desc: Pagal tikrą istoriją sukurta biografinė drama, pasakojanti apie netikėtą inteligentiško, talentingo juodaodžio pianisto Donaldo Širlio ir netašyto italų kilmės apsaugininko iš Bronkso - Frenkio "Lūpos" Valelongos draugystę. Praėjusio amžiaus viduryje pietinėse Amerikos valstijose dar galiojo segregacijos įstatymai, pagal kuriuos buvo legalu neįsileisti ar neaptarnauti juodaodžių įvairiose paslaugų ir pramogų vietose. (Green Book). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Hičkokas.
programme.desc: 1959 m. seras Alfredas Hičkokas ir jo žmona Alma Revil yra kūrybinės karjeros viršūnėje, o nerimą keliančios užuominos apie brandų amžių, jų nejaudina. Norėdamas susigrąžinti jaunystėje turėtą menininko drąsą, seras Alfredas nusprendžia, kad kitas jo filmas bus siaubo romano "Psichopatas" adaptacija, nors pritariančių šiam sprendimui nėra. Deja, serui Alfredui savarankiškai finansuojant ir dirbant prie šio filmo, Alma galiausiai praranda kantrybę dėl pasikeitusio vyro elgesio ir per didelės jo kontrolės aktorių atžvilgiu. Kai ambicingas draugas įkalba moterį bendradarbiauti kuriant naują scenarijų, dėl to santuokoje kylanti įtampa nuspalvina sero Alfredo juostą. (Hitchcock). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Yves Saint Laurent.
programme.desc: Paryžius, 1958 metų sausis. Yvui Saint Laurentui 21-eri, jis pristato savo pirmąją kolekciją Diorui. Jis dar nežino, kokia svaigi karjera ir beprotiška meilė jo laukia. Didžiulė sėkmė ir gilių jausmų užuomazga mecenatui Pierrui Berge, kuris taps viso jo gyvenimo meile ir verslo partneriu, leidžia sukurti Yves Saint Laurent imperiją - vieną žinomiausių prekių ženklų mados ir prabangos pasaulyje.﻿. (Yves Saint Laurent). Dramos.

programme.title: Spausk "groti".

programme.title: Tu nesi tu.
programme.desc: Vienai gerai moteriai, atėjo vidurinio amžiaus krizė ir ne už ilgo, ją pradėjo kamuoti stiprūs galvos skausmai. Nusibodus tai kentėti, moteris kreipėsi į ligoninę, kur po atliktų būtinų analizių, buvo nustatyta, kad gyventi jai liko ne taip ir ilgai. Po išgirstos diagnozės, jos gyvenimas prarado prasmę. Dienos tapo pilkos, o aplink ji nieko nebepastebi. Bet viskas pasikeičia sutikus paprastą, kiek vėjavaikę, savanaudę, jauną merginą. (You're Not You). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Toli nuo skubančios minios.
programme.desc: Batšeba Everdin - graži, nepriklausoma ir užsispyrusi mergina. Ji šeimininkauja savo ūkyje ir puikiai tvarkosi viena, kol į jos širdį pasibeldžia visa griaunantys jausmai. Jauna ir žavi anglė patraukia trijų labai skirtingų gerbėjų dėmesį - merginai meilę išpažįsta ir avių augintojas Gabrielis Oukas, ir bebaimis karininkas Frenkas Trojus, ir labai turtingas bei perspektyvus viengungis Viljamas Boldvudas. (Far from the Madding Crowd). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Šunų sala.

programme.title: Dar stipresnis.
programme.desc: Džefas Baumanas tikrai nebuvo iš tų, kuriuos galima pavadinti idealiais vaikinais. Ne, jis nebuvo girtuoklis ar mušeika. Tik visiškai neteikė reikšmės tam, kas buvo svarbu jo merginai Erinai. Po eilinio barnio Džefas ryžtingai nusprendžia pabandyti pasikeisti. Žinodamas, koks Erinai svarbus artėjantis Bostono maratonas, vaikinas pasižada nė už ką nepraleisti šio įvykio ir pasitikti mylimąją prie finišo linijos. (Stronger). Dramos.

programme.title: Gyvenimo verpetai.
programme.desc: Aštuoniasdešimtmetė Džulija žvelgia atgal į savo gyvenimo sprendimus ir svarsto, kaip susiklosčiusios aplinkybės galėjo nukreipti jos likimą visiškai kitais keliais. (Le Tourbillon de la vie). [16+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Solo.
programme.desc: Pasakojimas apie Simoną, kuris išgyvena nusivylimą dėl dviejų neįmanomų meilių: aistringo, bet destruktyvaus susižavėjimo Oliveriu, ir šaltų bei santūrių santykių su motina Kler, kuri grįžo į jo gyvenimą po 15 metų pertraukos. (Solo). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Ofelija.
programme.desc: Maištingą motinos netekusią Ofeliją karalienė Gertrūda priima į Elsinoro pilį kaip vieną patikimiausių savo rato merginų. Netrukus Ofelija užkariauja jaunojo princo Hamleto širdį. Kai karalystė atsiduria ant karo slenksčio, tarp jų slapta užsimezga aistringas romanas. Po tėvo žmogžudystės princas Hamletas ima alsuoti nepasotinamu keršto troškimu, o Ofelija bando suprasti Danijos valdžios taisykles ir kartu renkasi tarp tikrosios meilės ir savo pačios gyvybės. (Ophelia). Dramos. Trileriai. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Gerumo stebuklas.
programme.desc: Augustas didžiąją dalį savo gyvenimo praleido ligoninėse. Berniuko sveikatai pagerėjus, jo tėvai nutaria leisti sūnų į mokyklą. Tačiau būsimasis penktokas labiausiai norėtų tapti nematomas. Išskirtinis jo veidas aplinkiniams yra tarsi žvilgsnių magnetas. Su berniuko išskirtinumu turi susigyventi mokiniai, tėvai ir mokytojai. Tačiau nuolat kitiems pasiruošusi padėti berniuko širdis galų gale nugali išankstinius nusistatymus ir parodo, kad tikrasis grožis visuomet slypi viduje. (Wonder). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Laikas gyventi.
programme.desc: Perspektyvią virtuvės šefę Almut ir neseniai išsiskyrusį Tobajų likimas suveda pačiu netikėčiausiu būdu. Vos tik susipažinę, jie visa širdimi pasineria į naujus santykius, kurių kiekvienas etapas - nuo pirmųjų susižavėjimo akimirkų iki šeimos sukūrimo - atskleidžia ne tik jautrius, meilės ir pilnatvės kupinus momentus, bet ir skaudžią tiesą, kuri išbandys jų tarpusavio ryšį. Juosta pasakoja dešimtmetį trunkančią poros meilės istoriją. (We Live in Time). Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Mokinys.
programme.desc: Ši biografinė juosta pasakoja apie aštuntojo-devintojo dešimtmečio įvykius, padėjusius pamatus tokiam Donaldui Trumpui, kokį dabar žino visas pasaulis. Tapęs prezidentu savo tėvo Fredo statybų kompanijoje "Trump Management", jaunasis Donaldas desperatiškai trokšta greitos ir svaiginančios sėkmės. Jis neblogai išmano pagrindines verslo taisykles, tačiau būdo staigiai pakilti į taip trokštamą viršūnę surasti niekaip nepavyksta. (The Apprentice). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Rifkino festivalis.
programme.desc: San Sebastiane, be galo žavingame Ispanijos mieste prie jūros, vyksta kasmetis kino festivalis. Čia susirenka žymiausi kino pasaulio atstovai. Jų laukia filmų peržiūros, spaudos konferencijos, vakarėliai ir apdovanojimų ceremonijos. Į festivalį atvyksta ir amerikiečių pora - pagyvenęs sinefilas Rifkinas su žmona. Jie iškart neria į saulės nutviekstos Ispanijos ir filmų magiją. Tačiau netrukus šeimos idilė ima braškėti. Žmonai užmezgus romaną su talentingu režisieriumi Filipu, Rifkinas iš pavydo vieną po kito žiūri klasikinius filmus ir netrukus netikėtai suliepsnoja meile žaviai ispanei. Žiūrovai pamatys gražiausias istorinio miesto vietas, o patyrusių kinomanų akys pastebės užuominas į Federico Fellinio, Orsono Welleso, Luiso Bunuelio, Ingmaro Bergmano ir Jeano-Luco Godard'o kūrybą Dar viena žavi W. Alleno komedija apie meno, meilės, žmogiškųjų kompleksų ir mirtingumo pasaulį. "Gyvenimas - tarsi filmas. Kartais tai komedija, drama arba romantinis filmas, tačiau visų pirma jis yra detektyvas", - teigė režisierius. (Rifkin's Festival). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Visi pasaulio pinigai.
programme.desc: 1973 m. Romoje buvo pagrobtas 16-metis Džonas, turtingiausio pasaulio žmogaus anūkas. Pagrobėjai pareikalavo 17 mln. dolerių išpirkos, bet senelis mokėti atsisakė. Desperatiškai išeities ieškanti Džono motina apie tokius pinigus net sapnuoti negali. O šykštus ir kietas buvęs uošvis apie išpirką nenori nė girdėti. Pagrindinis tokio jo sprendimo motyvas – sumokėjus nusikaltėliams, šiems atsivertų nauja "uždarbio" galimybė ir tuomet pavojuje atsidurtų visi 14 jo anūkų. Motinai į pagalbą atskuba buvęs CŽV agentas Flečeris Čeisas. Kartu su į neviltį puolusia Džono motina Flečeris bando surasti išeitį iš beviltiškos situacijos. Kino grandas Ridley'is Scott'as pasakoja kvapą gniaužiančią, pagal tikrus įvykius sukurtą istoriją – "Visi pasaulio pinigai". (All the Money in the World). Dramos. Kriminalai. Mistika. Trileriai.

Desperatiškai išeities ieškanti Džono motina apie tokius pinigus net sapnuoti negali. O šykštus ir kietas buvęs uošvis apie išpirką nenori nė girdėti. Pagrindinis tokio jo sprendimo motyvas – sumokėjus nusikaltėliams, šiems atsivertų nauja "uždarbio" galimybė ir tuomet pavojuje atsidurtų visi 14 jo anūkų. Motinai į pagalbą atskuba buvęs CŽV agentas Flečeris Čeisas. Kartu su į neviltį puolusia Džono motina Flečeris bando surasti išeitį iš beviltiškos situacijos. Kino grandas Ridley'is Scott'as pasakoja kvapą gniaužiančią, pagal tikrus įvykius sukurtą istoriją – "Visi pasaulio pinigai". (All the Money in the World). Mistika. Trileriai. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Rifkino festivalis.
programme.desc: San Sebastiane, be galo žavingame Ispanijos mieste prie jūros, vyksta kasmetis kino festivalis. Čia susirenka žymiausi kino pasaulio atstovai. Jų laukia filmų peržiūros, spaudos konferencijos, vakarėliai ir apdovanojimų ceremonijos. Į festivalį atvyksta ir amerikiečių pora - pagyvenęs sinefilas Rifkinas su žmona. Jie iškart neria į saulės nutviekstos Ispanijos ir filmų magiją. Tačiau netrukus šeimos idilė ima braškėti. Žmonai užmezgus romaną su talentingu režisieriumi Filipu, Rifkinas iš pavydo vieną po kito žiūri klasikinius filmus ir netrukus netikėtai suliepsnoja meile žaviai ispanei. Žiūrovai pamatys gražiausias istorinio miesto vietas, o patyrusių kinomanų akys pastebės užuominas į Federico Fellinio, Orsono Welleso, Luiso Bunuelio, Ingmaro Bergmano ir Jeano-Luco Godard'o kūrybą Dar viena žavi W. Alleno komedija apie meno, meilės, žmogiškųjų kompleksų ir mirtingumo pasaulį. "Gyvenimas - tarsi filmas. Kartais tai komedija, drama arba romantinis filmas, tačiau visų pirma jis yra detektyvas", - teigė režisierius. (Rifkin's Festival). Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Mokinys.
programme.desc: Ši biografinė juosta pasakoja apie aštuntojo-devintojo dešimtmečio įvykius, padėjusius pamatus tokiam Donaldui Trumpui, kokį dabar žino visas pasaulis. Tapęs prezidentu savo tėvo Fredo statybų kompanijoje "Trump Management", jaunasis Donaldas desperatiškai trokšta greitos ir svaiginančios sėkmės. Jis neblogai išmano pagrindines verslo taisykles, tačiau būdo staigiai pakilti į taip trokštamą viršūnę surasti niekaip nepavyksta. (The Apprentice). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Idealus vyras.
programme.desc: Sunkiai besiverčiantis rašytojas randa trumpiausią kelią į šlovę, šantažuotojas grasina sugriauti tobulą gyvenimą. (Un homme Ideal). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Viešbutis "Didysis Budapeštas".
programme.desc: Viešbučio "Grand Budapest" durininkas Gustavas susidraugauja su jaunu kolega, kuris tampa jo patikėtiniu. Rodos, Gustavo gyvenimas gražus, kaip niekad, bet... koks gi prabangus viešbutis be paslaptingų piktadarių ir intrigų? Budapešto viešbučio ramybę sudrumsčia brangaus Renesanso epochos paveikslo vagystė, tad Gustavas priverstas pasiraitoti išlygintas savo rankoves ir kibti į kovą už garbę. (The Grand Budapest Hotel). Nuotykių. Komedijos. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Sprendimas išvykti.
programme.desc: Vyro žūtį kalnuose tiriantis detektyvas, atkakliai ieškodamas nusikaltimo įrodymų, susipažįsta su paslaptinga mirusiojo žmona. (Heojil kyolshim). Romantiniai. Mistika. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Miestas saloje.
programme.desc: Istorija apie šeimą, kurios nariai neturi bendrų įpročių, siekių ir veiklos. Kruopščiai supintas jų melagysčių voratinklis pradeda irti, kai pataisos namuose dirbantis, tačiau apie aktoriaus karjerą svajojantis Vincas namo parsiveda jauną buvusį kalinį. (City Island). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Provokuojantys užrašai.
programme.desc: Neturtingos šeimos išugdytas 16-metis paauglys Klodas (aktorius Ernstas Umhaueris) tik iš pažiūros atrodo ramus, drovus ir nekaltas lyg avinėlis. Jis vengia griebtis iniciatyvos, mėgsta tylenio taktiką, paslaptingu žvilgsniu tyrinėja aplinkinius žmones ir klasėje nuolat slepiasi paskutiniame suole. Tačiau visiškai kitoks Klodas atsiskleidžia rašydamas ir vaizdingai perteikdamas mintis, kupinas vojerizmo, klastos ir erotiškumo. (Dans la maison). Trileriai. Mistika. Dramos.

programme.title: Pažadėtoji žemė.
programme.desc: Kapitonas Ludvigas Kalenas nusprendžia užkariauti atšiaurias Jutlandijos pusiasalio teritorijas, norėdamas įgyvendinti kone neįmanomą tikslą - karaliaus vardu ten įkurti koloniją. Mainais už tai jam siūlomas kilmingojo titulas. Tačiau arogantiškas ir negailestingas šių teritorijų valdovas Frederikas de Šinkelis nenusiteikęs atiduoti jam priklausančių žemių be kovos. Kai de Šinkelis sužino, kad jo tarnaitė An Barbara su vyru mėgina gauti prieglobstį Kaleno draugijoje, pagiežingasis valdovas prisiekia bet kokia kaina išstumti kapitoną iš savo valdų. Filmas rodytas Venecijos kino festivalyje, Europos šalių kino forume "Scanorama". (Bastarden). [12+]. Veiksmo. Dramos.

programme.title: Dėl viso pikto.
programme.desc: Keturiasdešimt penkerių metų našlys Ervanas vieną dieną netyčia sužino, kad jį užauginęs vyras nėra jo biologinis tėvas. Vyras pasisamdo privačią detektyvę, kad padėtų rasti tikrojo tėtušio pėdsakus. Pasirodo, tikrasis tėvas - Žozefas, vyras, kurį Ervano motina pažinojo labai trumpai. Suglumęs Ervanas supranta, kad gražuolė Ana, kurią įsimylėjo beieškodamas tikrojo tėvo, yra Žozefo duktė. Viskas apsiverčia aukštyn kojomis... Dvi nominacijos Belgijos Magritte kino apdovanojimuose. Aktorius Francois Damiensas nominuotas prancūzų "Krištoliniam gaubliui". Iš viso 1 kino apdovanojimas ir 4 nominacijos. Rodytas Vilniaus Europos šalių kino forume "Scanorama". (Otez-moi d'un doute). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Vienintelė galimybė.
programme.desc: Kiekvienas gyvenime sulaukia šlovės akimirkos. Net jei tau jau trisdešimt septyneri, nesi gražuolis, dirbi mažoje mobiliųjų telefonų parduotuvėje, gyveni pas tėvus palėpėje ir svajoji tik apie vieną... dainuoti operos scenoje. 2007 metų kovo 17 dieną po daugelio išbandymų ir patirtų patyčių mėgėjas operos dainininkas Polas Potsas, dalyvaudamas kultiniame talentų šou "Britanijos talentai", tampa pasaulinio garso žvaigžde. Čikagos kino festivalyje pelnė žiūrovų prizą. Nominuotas "Aukso gaubliui" už originalią dainą. Iš viso 3 kino padovanojimai ir 5 nominacijos. (One Chance). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Deivo bankas.
programme.desc: Paremta tikra Deivo Fišviko istorija. Filme pasakojama istorija apie Bernlio miestelį ir milijonierių Deivą, kuris sugalvojo atidaryti banką bendruomenei, kad padėtų vietiniam verslui klestėti. Šioje kelionėje jis turi kovoti su Londono bankų institucijomis ir įtikinti, kad leistų jam atidaryti pirmą banką per 100 metų. (BANK OF DAVE). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

Jis neblogai išmano pagrindines verslo taisykles, tačiau būdo staigiai pakilti į taip trokštamą viršūnę surasti niekaip nepavyksta. (The Apprentice). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Motinos instinktas.
programme.desc: Idiliški 1960-ieji. Geriausias drauges Alisą ir Seliną supa rami ir harmoninga priemiesčio kaimynystė - rami aplinka, dailiai išpuoselėti namai, preciziškai nupjauta žolė... Tačiau staiga įvykusi tragiška nelaimė sudaužys jų laimingus gyvenimus į šipulius. (Mothers' Instinct). [12+]. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Šimtametis, kuris išlipo pro langą ir dingo.
programme.desc: Nugyvenęs ilgą ir gražų gyvenimą, artėjant prie šimtmečio Alanas Karlsonas atsiduria senelių namuose, tikėdamas, kad tai - jau paskutinė stotelė. Tačiau sveikata vyras niekuomet nesiskundė, o leisti dienas su nukvakusiais senukais irgi nebuvo Alano svajonė. Todėl savo 100 metų jubiliejų vyras nusprendžia atšvęsti su trenksmu: išsiruošti į dar vieną kelionę, kokių jo gyvenime jau buvo tūkstančiai. Vien su šlepetėmis (kad niekas neįtartų), Alanas išlipa pro langą ir dingsta. (The 100 Year-Old Man Who Climbed Out the Window and Disappeared). Komedijos. Nuotykių.

programme.title: Ezra.
programme.desc: Tonio Goldvino filme "Ezra" pasakojama apie Maksą Bernalį, komiką, gyvenantį su tėvu, kuris kartu su buvusia žmona Džena stengiasi auginti autizmu sergantį sūnų Ezrą. Priversti priimti sunkius sprendimus dėl ateities, Maksas ir Ezra išsiruošia į kelionę per visą šalį, kuri kardinaliai pakeis judviejų gyvenimus. (Ezra). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Penktasis Bitlas.
programme.desc: 1961 m. lapkričio 9 d. baldų pardavėjas Brajanas Epšteinas užsuko į Liverpulio rūsyje įsikūrusį klubą ir buvo taip sužavėtas to, ką pamatė, kad nusprendė tapti kylančios ir mažai žinomos grupės "The Beatles", kuri ten koncertavo, vadybininku. Brajanas leidosi į audringą kelionę, tikėdamasis, kad Liverpulio ketvertas taps populiaresnis už Elvį Preslį. Nepaisant sudėtingų santykių grupės viduje, kovos su savimi ir aplinkinių skepticizmo, "penktasis bitlas" išsikėlė sau neįmanomą užduotį - suvienyti žmoniją per taiką, meilę ir popmuziką - ir sukūrė pasaulinį reiškinį. (Midas Man). [12+]. Muzikiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Jevida.
programme.desc: Pagyvenusi skoltų samė Iida, kuri dėl asimiliacijos spaudimo atsižadėjo savo praeities, keliauja per tris skirtingas istorines epochas, atskleisdama Suomijos čiabuvių likimą pokariu. (Je'vida). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Laiškai Džuljetai.
programme.desc: Verona - nuostabus Italijos miestas, kuriame susipažino Romeo su Džiuljeta. Šiame mieste įskaudintos merginos palieka raštelius Džiuljetai, prašydamos patarimo. Atostogaudama Veronoje, rašytoja Sofi netikėtai randa prieš penkiasdešimt metų parašytą laišką. Įkvėpta radinio, Sofi leidžiasi į romantinę kelionę su laiško autore Klara ir jos gražuoliu anūku. Trijulė netrunka įsitikinti, kad kartais nuostabiausia meilės istorija yra būtent ta, kuri nutinka tau. (Letters to Juliet). Komedijos. Romantiniai. Nuotykių. Dramos.

programme.title: Mančesteris prie jūros.
programme.desc: Ly Čandleris, atrodo, stengiasi gyventi taip, kad jo niekas nepastebėtų. Valytojas, atliekantis įvairius pagalbinius darbus viename daugiabutyje, yra nekalbus, gyvena vienas ir užsisklendęs. Niekas nežino šio vyro gyvenimo istorijos. Netrukus Ly pasiekia žinia apie mylimo brolio Džo mirtį. Jis grįžta į Mančesterį prie jūros, kur pats kadaise gyveno. Nuvykęs pas brolio advokatą Ly gauna šoką, nes sužino, kad jam Džo paliko savo paauglio sūnaus Patriko globą. Ly jokiu būdu nenori grįžti gyventi į šią vietą - per daug blogų jausmų ir prisiminimų. Jis nori sūnėną išsivežti į Bostoną, bet Patrikas priešinasi. Per laidotuves Ly sutinka savo buvusią žmoną Rendę. Per dabarties ir praeities vaizdus žiūrovams po truputį atskleidžiama sukrečianti Ly gyvenimo tragedija ir paaiškėja, kodėl jis taip nenori vėl gyventi Mačesteryje prie jūros... Puikus psichologinis filmas sužavi tikroviškumu ir labai įtikinamai atskleistais veikėjų portretais. Šiame filme atsiskleidė naujas kino talentas - už pagrindinį Ly vaidmenį, jį sukūręs Beno Afflecko brolis Casey Affleckas pelnė visus tris svarbiausius apdovanojimus: "Oskarą", "Auksinį gaublį", BAFTA prizą ir daugelį kitų, taip pat sulaukė išskirtinio kritikų pripažinimo. Jo žmoną Rendę vaidina talentingoji Michelle Williams. Filmas iš viso nominuotas net šešiems Oskarams (du iš jų laimėjo - už pagrindinį vyro vaidmenį ir scenarijų). (Manchester by the Sea). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Apgaulinga aistra.
programme.desc: Ant žurnalų viršelių besipuikuojantis verslininkas Robertas Milleris (akt. Richard Gere) iš pirmo žvilgsnio yra tikras sėkmės džentelmenas, kurio kišenėse ir banko sąskaitose - milijonai dolerių. Jis laimingas šeimos vyras, turintis nuostabią žmoną (akt. Susan Sarandon) ir mielą dukterį (akt. Birt Marling) bei... charizmatiškas meilužis, kurio glėbyje šildosi jauna gražuolė. Tačiau vieną dieną sėkmė nuo jo nusisuka. (Arbitrage). Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Žalioji knyga.
programme.desc: Pagal tikrą istoriją sukurta biografinė drama, pasakojanti apie netikėtą inteligentiško, talentingo juodaodžio pianisto Donaldo Širlio ir netašyto italų kilmės apsaugininko iš Bronkso - Frenkio "Lūpos" Valelongos draugystę. Praėjusio amžiaus viduryje pietinėse Amerikos valstijose dar galiojo segregacijos įstatymai, pagal kuriuos buvo legalu neįsileisti ar neaptarnauti juodaodžių įvairiose paslaugų ir pramogų vietose. (Green Book). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Praeities šešėlis.
programme.desc: Trisdešimt šešerių Greisi įsimylėjo trylikametį ir, kai kartą porelė buvo užklupta besimylinti, Greisi už nepilnamečio tvirkinimą sėdo už grotų. Šią pikantišką istoriją plačiai nušvietė žiniasklaida, jos susidomėjimas išaugo dar labiau, kai Greisi kalėjime gimė mergaitė. Iki ausų įsimylėjęs tėvas Džo sulaukė, kol Greisi atliks bausmę, ir jiedu susituokė. Praėjus 20 metų šią pikantišką uždraustos meilės istoriją ruošiamasi perkelti į kino ekranus. Norėdama kuo geriau pažinti savo heroję, Greisi vaidinsianti Holivudo aktorė Elizabet Beri atvyksta į poros namus. Svetimo žmogaus atsiradimas šeimoje suveikia kaip katalizatorius, o žvilgsnis iš šalies suardo nusistovėjusią Greisi ir Džo šeimos rutiną ir santykių dinamiką. Juosta buvo nominuota keturiems "Auksiniams gaubliams". (May December). Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Tiesos kadras.
programme.desc: Tikra istorija apie amerikiečių fotografę ir modelį Lee Miller (akt. Kate Winslet), kuri tapo karo korespondente žurnalui "Vogue" per Antrąjį pasaulinį karą. Kate Winslet už šį vaidmenį pelnė "Auksinio gaublio" nominaciją. (Lee). Dramos.

programme.title: Žalioji knyga.
programme.desc: Pagal tikrą istoriją sukurta biografinė drama, pasakojanti apie netikėtą inteligentiško, talentingo juodaodžio pianisto Donaldo Širlio ir netašyto italų kilmės apsaugininko iš Bronkso - Frenkio "Lūpos" Valelongos draugystę. Praėjusio amžiaus viduryje pietinėse Amerikos valstijose dar galiojo segregacijos įstatymai, pagal kuriuos buvo legalu neįsileisti ar neaptarnauti juodaodžių įvairiose paslaugų ir pramogų vietose. programme.title: Praeities šešėlis.
programme.desc: Trisdešimt šešerių Greisi įsimylėjo trylikametį ir, kai kartą porelė buvo užklupta besimylinti, Greisi už nepilnamečio tvirkinimą sėdo už grotų. Šią pikantišką istoriją plačiai nušvietė žiniasklaida, jos susidomėjimas išaugo dar labiau, kai Greisi kalėjime gimė mergaitė. Iki ausų įsimylėjęs tėvas Džo sulaukė, kol Greisi atliks bausmę, ir jiedu susituokė. Praėjus 20 metų šią pikantišką uždraustos meilės istoriją ruošiamasi perkelti į kino ekranus. Norėdama kuo geriau pažinti savo heroję, Greisi vaidinsianti Holivudo aktorė Elizabet Beri atvyksta į poros namus. Svetimo žmogaus atsiradimas šeimoje suveikia kaip katalizatorius, o žvilgsnis iš šalies suardo nusistovėjusią Greisi ir Džo šeimos rutiną ir santykių dinamiką. Juosta buvo nominuota keturiems "Auksiniams gaubliams". (May December). Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Provokuojantys užrašai.
programme.desc: Neturtingos šeimos išugdytas 16-metis paauglys Klodas (aktorius Ernstas Umhaueris) tik iš pažiūros atrodo ramus, drovus ir nekaltas lyg avinėlis. Jis vengia griebtis iniciatyvos, mėgsta tylenio taktiką, paslaptingu žvilgsniu tyrinėja aplinkinius žmones ir klasėje nuolat slepiasi paskutiniame suole. Tačiau visiškai kitoks Klodas atsiskleidžia rašydamas ir vaizdingai perteikdamas mintis, kupinas vojerizmo, klastos ir erotiškumo. (Dans la maison). Mistika. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Pabaigos jausmas.
programme.desc: Vyrą pradeda persekioti atsiminimai apie praeitį. Netikėtai atsiradęs paslaptingas palikimas priverčia jį permąstyti dabartinį savo gyvenimą. (The Sense of an Ending). Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Maištininkas rugiuose.
programme.desc: Pradedantysis rašytojas Džeromas Selindžeris pradeda lankyti įkvepiančius rašymo kursus Kolumbijos universitete. Tačiau nerūpestingą jaunuolio gyvenimą negailestingai nutraukia Antrasis pasaulinis karas, kurio metu jis pradėjo rašyti savo romaną. Nepaisant po karo išgyventos gilios depresijos, kūrybinės krizės ir destruktyvaus elgesio, jis galiausiai užbaigia kūrinį, kuris atneša jam šlovę. "Rugiuose prie bedugnės" romano autoriaus Džeromo Selindžerio biografinė istorija filme – "Maištininkas rugiuose". (Rebel in the Rye). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.
programme.desc: On this trip, Guy Fieri is tasting everything from pasta to potatoes, and he's got some grub for his pescatarian friends. First up, Vanilla Ice takes Guy to his favorite Ecuadorian joint in West Palm Beach, Fla., for standout ceviche. Then, in Moorhead, Minn., a former DJ mixes it up with his take on scratch-made pasta and poutine, and, in the Florida Keys, a local landmark is poundin' out hits like their chicken and smash. (Diners, Drive-ins and Dives). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Beat Bobby Flay.
programme.desc: Two talented chefs go head-to-head for the chance to Beat Bobby Flay. To get to Bobby the chefs must first face off against each other, creating a spectacular dish with a secret ingredient of Bobby's choice. Judges Alex Guarnaschelli and Jeff Mauro know Bobby's strengths and his weaknesses. Their goal: Pick the chef who has the skills to take down Bobby Flay in his own arena. The winning chef gets to challenge Bobby with his or her surprise signature dish. If Bobby goes down, the winner can tell the world, "I beat Bobby Flay!" (Beat Bobby Flay). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten.

programme.title: Be My Guest With Ina Garten.
programme.desc: Eric Ripert, the incredible chef and world-class restaurateur behind the three Michelin star Le Bernardin restaurant in New York, stops by the barn to cook and share his career highs, childhood lows and life-changing stories. Ina Garten welcomes him with a French Apple Tart, a favorite dessert from his childhood, before Eric demonstrates how to make Seared Tuna with a Ginger Soy Salad, a stunning restaurant dish anyone can make at home. programme.title: Bizarre Foods.
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals. (Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Alex Vs America.
programme.desc: Chef Alex and three skilled chefs from across the U.S. take on an iconic American ingredient: Beef. Joining the fight from Oklahoma, Georgia and Texas, these beef pros will take their shot at knocking Alex out of the top spot. The chefs will strategize what ingredients to use and test their abilities against Alex. Judges Michael Voltaggio and Cara Nicoletti will decided if these beef chefs can keep Alex on her toes or if she will walk all over them. (Alex Vs America). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Alex Vs America.
programme.desc: Host Eric Adjepong welcomes three chocolatiers from Tennessee, Florida and California to the arena to take on classically trained Chef Alex Guarnaschelli in a competition for dessert domination. The chefs must strategize what ingredients to use in round one in hopes of knocking Chef Alex out of the competition. In round two, the remaining chefs rely on their knowledge of chocolate work to vie for the top spot and the chance to win $10,000 as awarded by judges Valerie Gordon and Jonathan Grahm. (Alex Vs America). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's samplin' fresh takes on soup, salad, sorbet and more! There's Mexican-Japanese fusion in Austin, Texas, puttin' a spin on traditional dishes with craveable carnitas ramen and a top-tier tostada with spicy tuna. In Cincinnati, a funky joint with nautical flair is platin' prime-time pulled pork poutine, mouthwatering mustard smash burgers, and savory sesame-ginger cauliflower wings. Plus, a family-run Thai spot in Los Angeles is puttin' their stamp on papaya piled high, the-bomb braised pork plate, and sorbet with a tom-yum twist. (Diners, Drive-ins and Dives). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's divin' into a smorgasbord of texture and flavor! A BBQ bistro in Sherman Oaks, Calif., is cookin' up eclectic riffs on the classics like sticky ribs with a Korean twist and the-bomb brisket noodles. There's an upscale diner from a husband-and-wife team in Cincinnati, doctoring up a dirty French burger with mouthwatering mornay sauce and platin' top-notch chili crunch chicken nuggets. And in Austin, Texas, a funky veggie-forward spot is firin' up from-scratch vegan patties with a chipotle pesto punch, plus a primo pasta margarita. (Diners, Drive-ins and Dives). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.
programme.desc: Guy Fieri's in Sicily, Italy, diggin' into all the local specialties! Coastal views and craveable flavors abound at this cliffside spot serving primo prawns over squid ink pasta and their house couscous with seafood medley. Then, it's a mouthwatering menu settin' street food front and center with A-list arancini, stuffed flatbread and fully loaded focaccia. Plus, a family-run joint down a cobblestone alley is putting their stamp on traditional dishes, scratch-makin' phenomenal fennel balls and next-level ravioli. (Diners, Drive-ins and Dives). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives.
programme.desc: Guy Fieri is in Sicily, Italy, eating up local flavor! (Diners, Drive-ins and Dives). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship.
programme.desc: Oh no! An ancient mummy is haunting the Fermentation Lab, munching on umami-filled ingredients like stinky cheese. This gives John Henson the idea for "umummy" desserts, and he tasks the bakers with creating sweet mummy treats that feature umami ingredients like red miso, aged parmesan, gochujang or soy sauce. Then, it's "bone appetit" for judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell as the bakers get inspired by the lab skeleton, Skelly, to create Skelly's forgotten desserts, where they must use Halloween mini chocolate bars to create skeletal desserts. (Halloween Baking Championship). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Halloween Baking Championship.
programme.desc: To celebrate 85 years of the wonderful Wizard of Oz, John Henson is in the lab's atmospheric chamber measuring the velocity of tornado desserts so that the bakers can honor Dorothy's rough trip to Oz. Then, the bakers visit the acid pit, where the spirits have been melting things. Inspired by those who have melted before, especially the Wicked Witch of the West, the bakers make melted witch desserts to appease the spirits, as well as judges Carla Hall, Zac Young and Stephanie Boswell. (Halloween Baking Championship). Maisto gamyba.

programme.title: Dinner: Impossible.

programme.title: Chopped.
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them.
