Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere. (Mr. Morgan's Last Love). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: You Ain't Seen Nothin' Yet.
programme.desc: From beyond the grave, celebrated playwright Antoine d'Anthac gathers together all his friends who have appeared over the years in his play "Eurydice." These actors watch a recording of the work performed by a young acting company, La Compagnie de la Colombe. During the screening, Antoine's friends are so overwhelmed by their memories of the play that they start performing it together, despite no longer being the appropriate age for their various roles. (Vous n'avez encore rien vu). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Princess of Montpensier.
programme.desc: France, 1562. Against a background of the savage Catholic/Protestant wars, Marie de Mézières (Mélanie Thierry), a beautiful young aristocrat, and the rakish Henri de Guise (Gaspard Ulliel) fall in love, but Marie's father has promised her hand in marriage to the Prince of Montpensier (Grégoire Leprince-Ringuet). When he is called away to battle, her husband leaves her in the care of Count Chabannes (Lambert Wilson), an aging nobleman with a disdain for warfare. As he experiences his own forbidden desire for Marie, Chabannes must also protect her from the dangerously corrupt court dominated by Catherine de Medici. (La princesse de Montpensier). [12+]. Veiksmo. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights.
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival. (Wuthering Heights). Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Family Life.
programme.desc: A young man spends a few weeks housekeeping for a distant relative. Soon, he meets a cute neighbor and starts pretending for his personal benefit. (Vida de Familia). [16+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Stealing Beauty.
programme.desc: Lucy Harmon, a nineteen-year-old American, is the daughter of well-known (now deceased) poet and model, Sara Harmon. The film opens as Lucy arrives for a vacation at the Tuscany villa of Sara's old friends, Ian and Diana Grayson (played by Donal McCann and Cusack, respectively). Other guests include a prominent New York art gallery owner, an Italian advice columnist and an English writer, Alex Parrish (Irons), who is dying of an unspecified disease. Lucy goes for a swim, and finds that Diana's daughter from a previous marriage, Miranda Fox (Weisz), is also there with her boyfriend, entertainment lawyer Richard Reed (D. W. Moffett). Miranda's brother, Christopher (Fiennes), is supposed to be there, but he is off on a road trip with the Italian son of a neighboring villa, Niccoló Donati (Roberto Zibetti). Lucy was particularly hoping to see Niccoló, whom she had met on a previous visit to the villa, four years earlier, and who was the first boy she'd ever kissed. Lucy and Niccoló had briefly exchanged letters after this first visit. One letter in particular Lucy had admired so much she memorized it. (Stealing Beauty). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: The Disobedient.
programme.desc: As children, Leni and Lazar were best friends. At Lazar's father's funeral, Leni yearns to reconnect with her friend but still feels the sting of their years of estrangement. (Neposlusni). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Mozart and the Whale.
programme.desc: A love story between two savants with Asperger's syndrome, a kind of autism whose effects sabotage their budding relationship. (Mozart and the Whale). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Painted Veil.
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth. (The Painted Veil). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Measure of a Man.
programme.desc: DI Dave Creegan is shot and, whilst unconscious, has a near-death experience that leaves him with the ability to sense criminals upon recovery. Joining the Organized and Serial Crime Unit with inspector Susan Taylor, Creegan learns from his friend Cyril, a self-proclaimed psychic, that two recently abducted boys have been murdered 'in the clouds'. In both cases, a daffodil has been left at the scene of the abduction, a fact reminiscent of similar crimes in Stuttgart some years earlier. A car at the last crime scene is traced to pharmaceutical chemist professor Ronald ... (La Loi du marché). Dramos.

programme.title: Rookie.
programme.desc: This is a story of lost dreams and second chances that is steeped in engine oil and the adrenaline of motorcycle racing. (Rookie). Veiksmo. Dramos.

programme.title: Pink Lady.
programme.desc: Battie and Lazer, a Jewish ultra-Orthodox couple are being blackmailed by the Wolf's gang. Both are going to fight the gang in a journey that will test their love and faith and change their lives forever. (Pink Lady). Dramos.

programme.title: Memphis.
programme.desc: A strange singer with God-given talent drifts through his adopted city of Memphis with its canopy of ancient oak trees, streets of shattered windows, and aura of burning spirituality. Surrounded by beautiful women, legendary musicians, a stone-cold hustler, a righteous preacher, and a wolf pack of kids, the sweet, yet unstable, performer avoids the recording studio, driven by his own form of self-discovery. His journey quickly drags him from love and happiness right to the edge of another dimension. (Memphis). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Santosh.
programme.desc: Newly widowed Santosh inherits her husband's job as a police constable in the rural badlands of Northern India. When a girl's body is found, she's pulled into the investigation under the wing of charismatic feminist inspector Sharma. (Santosh). [12+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: She's Lost Control.
programme.desc: While studying for her master's degree, Ronah works as sexual surrogate in New York City under therapist Dr. Alan Cassidy. Cassidy refers to her a new client, Johnny, a man with intimacy issues. On their first appointment, Johnny drinks alcohol, which Ronah discourages, though she says he can discuss the matter with Cassidy. Johnny's hostility to Ronah's attempts to get him to open up eventually leads him to reveal in one session that he does not trust her and desires to strangle her. In her progress reports with Cassidy, Ronah confirms her desire to continue working with him, as she does not want to give up on him. Johnny continues to drink during their sessions, citing a guideline from Cassidy that one drink before their session is fine. (She's Lost Control). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Last Orders.
programme.desc: On a cold winter day, Bear puts on his nightcap and decides to take a nice winter's nap. However, it would seem that others in the Big Blue House have other plans for Bear. Ojo comes to Bear in alarm --- concerned about the sudden disappearance of her duck friends from the Otter Pond. Bear makes her a cup of cocoa and tells her about migration. Treelo takes Bear outside, telling him there's feathers falling from the sky. Bear introduces him to the delights of snow. Bear finally settles down for the nap, but is woken up by Pip and Pop. They take him outside, where all the kids have a special surprise for him. Tutter's been trying to take a nap too, but with all the noise, he finds himself just as awake as Bear. In the Shadow segment, Shadow tries to help Bear get to sleep. She sings "Rockabye Baby." Songs In the Middle of Winter Notes In this episode, Ojo talks about her duck friends out at the Otter Pond. Duck characters were first seen on the program in the third season, with the introduction of Harry and his Mom in "Lost and Found." (Last Orders). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Every Thing Will Be Fine.
programme.desc: Tomas Eldan is a novelist, living with Sara in a rural area of Quebec. Their relationship is strained, as she wants marriage and children while he just wants to focus on his writing. Tomas is driving home on a wintery rural road when a toboggan carrying brothers Christopher and Nicholas slides into the path of his vehicle, resulting in Nicholas' death but causing no physical damage to five-year-old Christopher. (Every Thing Will Be Fine). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom.
programme.desc: Biopic that sees Idris Elba play the South African lawyer who campaigned restlessly against apartheid in the 1940s before becoming one of the greatest leaders of the modern age. It chronicles Nelson Mandela's journey from childhood in a rural village, to prominent figure in a political movement striving for equality, to 27 years of imprisonment, and finally to his inauguration as South Africa's president. (Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Don't Come Knocking.
programme.desc: Shepard stars as Howard Spence, an aging, hard-living Western (genre) star, who, disgusted with his life & washed up, flees by horse from the set of his latest western filming in the desert outside Moab, Utah, Utah. He hits the road looking for refuge in his past, traveling to his hometown of Elko, Nevada, Nevada to visit his mother, who he hasn't seen in 30 years. And, eventually, to Butte, Montana, Montana, looking for a woman (Jessica Lange) he left behind twenty years before when he was filming a movie there. Also converging on Butte is a young woman named Sky (Sarah Polley), returning her late mother's ashes to her hometown and conducting a search of her own. (Don't Come Knocking). [12+]. Dramos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Tale of Cinema.
programme.desc: As the film begins, Sangwon, an aimless and indecisive college student on school holiday after final examinations, avoids walking together with his older brother by instead taking a side street, where he finds a former girlfriend, Yongsil, working at an optician's store. Unsure of his own emotional preparedness in rekindling the relationship, he decides to watch a play while waiting for her to complete her work shift, delaying the decision to meet her later in the evening. The final words of anguish in the play, uttered by a desperately ill child unable to be comforted by his mother, would later be echoed by Sangwon from the rooftop of his parents' apartment after his own failed act of despair. In the film's corollary chapter, Tongsu, a struggling, rootless, and inscrutable filmmaker who has become obsessed with a short film directed by his former classmate - and in particular, the devoted and obliging woman in the film - encounters the young actress in person and begins to ingratiate himself into her company, acting out his projected image of her by imitating gestures and revisiting locations from the film in an attempt to realize his own created image of her. (Tale of Cinema). Dramos.

programme.title: The Most Fun You Can Have Dying.
programme.desc: The murder of Richard Speigel, chief financial officer for an exclusive, family-owned department store goes from the sitting room to the bedroom and into the board room as suspicion shifts from co-workers to family members. (The Most Fun You Can Have Dying). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Romantiniai.

Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Muzikiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Little One.
programme.desc: In this hilarious comedy, after a happy young couple have just welcomed their first child, the four new grandparents start vying for exclusive control of the baby in a rivalry that spirals out of control. (Boutchou). Komedijos.

programme.title: Death on the Nile.
programme.desc: During a luxurious pleasure cruise down the Nile aboard a lavish vessel populated with wealthy passengers, widely despised heiress and home wrecker Linnet Ridgeway is murdered. Also aboard is famed Belgian detective Poirot and his taciturn traveling companion, Colonel Race. Poirot undertakes an investigation into Ridgeway's killing, but as more bodies pile up, it appears that nearly everyone aboard has a motive. (Death on the Nile). [18+]. Dramos. Kriminalai. Mistika.

programme.title: Plancha.
programme.desc: To celebrate Yves' 50th birthday, his friends plan to take him to the sunny paradise of Paros in Greece. But due to a flight cancellation, the holiday will take place in a much rainier destination: Yves' family home in Brittany. (Plancha). Komedijos.

programme.title: The Measure of a Man.
programme.desc: DI Dave Creegan is shot and, whilst unconscious, has a near-death experience that leaves him with the ability to sense criminals upon recovery. Joining the Organized and Serial Crime Unit with inspector Susan Taylor, Creegan learns from his friend Cyril, a self-proclaimed psychic, that two recently abducted boys have been murdered 'in the clouds'. In both cases, a daffodil has been left at the scene of the abduction, a fact reminiscent of similar crimes in Stuttgart some years earlier. A car at the last crime scene is traced to pharmaceutical chemist professor Ronald ... (La Loi du marché). Dramos.

programme.title: Rookie.
programme.desc: This is a story of lost dreams and second chances that is steeped in engine oil and the adrenaline of motorcycle racing. (Rookie). Dramos. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Brideshead Revisited.
programme.desc: Although he aspires to become an artist, middle-class Charles Ryder reads history at the University of Oxford, where he befriends the flamboyant and wealthy Lord Sebastian Flyte. Sebastian's mother, Lady Marchmain, strongly disapproves of Sebastian's lifestyle, especially his heavy drinking. When Sebastian takes Charles home to visit his nanny, Charles is enthralled by the grandeur of the Marchmain family estate, known as Brideshead, and he is entranced by its residents, including the devout Roman Catholic Lady Marchmain and her other children, Sebastian's elder brother Bridey and his sisters Julia and Cordelia. (Brideshead Revisited). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Highway 65.
programme.desc: A promising police officer, Daphna, finds herself in a small town handling petty crimes, but the disappearance of a former beauty queen, Orly, raises questions no one seems interested in answering. (Highway 65). Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: The Green Perfume.
programme.desc: In the middle of a performance at la Comédie-Française, an actor dies on stage, poisoned. Martin, member of the troupe and friend of the victim, becomes the center of everyone's attention. Suspected by the police, he's also chased by a mysterious organization, Le Parfum vert, that seems to have ordered the murder. (Le Parfum vert). Trileriai. Mistika. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Ramen Shop.
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients. (Ramen Teh). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Family Life.
programme.desc: A young man spends a few weeks housekeeping for a distant relative. Soon, he meets a cute neighbor and starts pretending for his personal benefit. (Vida de Familia). [16+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Ladykillers.
programme.desc: The last of the great Ealing comedies. Despite a distinguished cast including Alec Guinness, Peter Sellers, Jack Warner and Herbert Lom, it is Katie Johnson who steals the show as the little old lady who innocently takes in a criminal gang believing them to be a string quintet. When she discovers that they have just robbed a bank and insists that they give themselves up to the police, the gang decide that Mrs Wilberforce must die - but none of them can steel themselves to kill her. Frankie Howerd also has a cameo role as a barrow boy. (The Ladykillers). [16+]. Komedijos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Mr. Morgan's Last Love.
programme.desc: Michael Caine and Clémence Poésy star in writer-director Sandra Nettlebeck's romantic comedy-drama. Retired philosophy professor Matthew Morgan (Caine) is a non-French-speaking American living in Paris. Recently widowed, he's attempting to come to terms with the loss of his much-loved wife (Jane Alexander), with whom he has fantasy chats. One day, he meets lonely young dance teacher Pauline (Poesy) on a bus, where she helps him out of an awkward situation. It's the start of a relaxed but close friendship that rekindles his dormant interest in life. She teaches him the cha-cha and he talks to her about the great thinkers of philosophy. But his sadness about his bereavement overwhelms him and he attempts to kill himself. Morgan's estranged children, Miles (Justin Kirk) and Karen (Gillian Anderson), turn up from America. They're both worried and angry about their father and his new friendship, not least because they believe Pauline might be a gold-digger. Network premiere. (Mr. Morgan's Last Love). [12+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: You Ain't Seen Nothin' Yet.
programme.desc: From beyond the grave, celebrated playwright Antoine d'Anthac gathers together all his friends who have appeared over the years in his play "Eurydice." These actors watch a recording of the work performed by a young acting company, La Compagnie de la Colombe. During the screening, Antoine's friends are so overwhelmed by their memories of the play that they start performing it together, despite no longer being the appropriate age for their various roles. (Vous n'avez encore rien vu). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: The Princess of Montpensier.
programme.desc: France, 1562. Against a background of the savage Catholic/Protestant wars, Marie de Mézières (Mélanie Thierry), a beautiful young aristocrat, and the rakish Henri de Guise (Gaspard Ulliel) fall in love, but Marie's father has promised her hand in marriage to the Prince of Montpensier (Grégoire Leprince-Ringuet). When he is called away to battle, her husband leaves her in the care of Count Chabannes (Lambert Wilson), an aging nobleman with a disdain for warfare. As he experiences his own forbidden desire for Marie, Chabannes must also protect her from the dangerously corrupt court dominated by Catherine de Medici. (La princesse de Montpensier). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Every Thing Will Be Fine.
programme.desc: Tomas Eldan is a novelist, living with Sara in a rural area of Quebec. Their relationship is strained, as she wants marriage and children while he just wants to focus on his writing. Tomas is driving home on a wintery rural road when a toboggan carrying brothers Christopher and Nicholas slides into the path of his vehicle, resulting in Nicholas' death but causing no physical damage to five-year-old Christopher. (Every Thing Will Be Fine). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom.

It chronicles Nelson Mandela's journey from childhood in a rural village, to prominent figure in a political movement striving for equality, to 27 years of imprisonment, and finally to his inauguration as South Africa's president. (Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Triumph Of Love.
programme.desc: Romantic comedy. Princess Aspasia falls in love with Agis. However, if he were to discover her true identity he would spurn her advances since his "father" has taught him to reject love. So, Aspasia dresses up as... Fokion and tries to seduce him. (The Triumph of Love). [16+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Outbound.
programme.desc: A drama about a woman who seems able to overcome everything for freedom, except for her past mistakes. (Periferic). Trileriai. Veiksmo. Dramos.

programme.title: The Last Emperor.
programme.desc: In 1950, Puyi has been kept in custody for five years, since the Red Army captured him during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria. In the recently established People's Republic of China, Puyi arrives as a political prisoner and war criminal at the Fushun War Criminals Management Centre. Soon after his arrival, Puyi attempts suicide, but is quickly revived and told he must stand trial. (The Last Emperor). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Edge of Love.
programme.desc: When the Welsh poet Dylan Thomas and his flirtatious wife Caitlin sweep into war-torn London, the last thing they expect is to bump into Dylan's childhood sweetheart Vera. But despite her joy at seeing Dylan after so many years, Vera is swept off her feet by a dashing officer, William Killick, and finds herself torn between the open adoration of her new-found beau and the wily charms of the exotic Welshman. William joins the war effort abroad and Vera finds herself spending more and more time with Caitlin while constantly having to fend off the advances of the amorous poet. When William returns, the incestuous bond between the trio sends him into a jealous rage. (The Edge of Love). Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: The Braves.
programme.desc: Margaux and Alma share a love of the theatre. Although sometimes finding themselves competing for a role, they remain best friends. Despite everything, they make progress and seem unstoppable. Alma and Margot's relationship really is ''for better and for worse''. (Entre les vagues). Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Memphis.
programme.desc: A strange singer with God-given talent drifts through his adopted city of Memphis with its canopy of ancient oak trees, streets of shattered windows, and aura of burning spirituality. Surrounded by beautiful women, legendary musicians, a stone-cold hustler, a righteous preacher, and a wolf pack of kids, the sweet, yet unstable, performer avoids the recording studio, driven by his own form of self-discovery. His journey quickly drags him from love and happiness right to the edge of another dimension. (Memphis). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: There's Only One Jimmy Grimble.
programme.desc: Jimmy Grimble (Lewis McKenzie (actor)) is a 15-year-old misfit living in Manchester, where nothing seems to go his way. Jimmy is constantly threatened by the school bully, "Gorgeous" Gordon (Bobby Power); he is also not sure what to make of Johnny (Ben Miller), a lost-in-the-ozone biker who is dating Donna (Gina McKee), Jimmy's mum; and he has a crush on one of his classmates, Sara (Samia Ghadie), who seems to like him, but his powers of speech fail him when he tries to talk to her. Like most Natives of Manchester, Jimmy loves football. He is a fervent supporter of Manchester City and attends home games with Donna's ex-boyfriend, Harry (Ray Winstone). Jimmy also loves to play football, but while Eric (Robert Carlyle), the coach of his school's team, thinks he has potential, "Gorgeous" is already a skilled player, and when Gordon's father informs the school he will make a large and much-needed donation if their team makes it to the Manchester Schools Cup final, it looks like Jimmy will be on the bench for a while. But when an old woman gives Jimmy a pair of boots that once belonged to one of City's greatest players, his skills on the field begin to change. (There's Only One Jimmy Grimble). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Like Someone In Love.
programme.desc: The veteran, multi-award-winning Iranian director Kiarostami Abbas chose Japan as the location for this intriguing drama, only the second feature he has made outside his homeland since his prolific career began in 1970. Rin Takanashi stars as Akiko, a young student in Tokyo who has turned to escort work to pay for her studies. Her latest job takes her to the city's suburbs, to the home of an elderly academic, Takashi (Tadashi Okuno). It transpires that he's more interested in companionship than sex, but will the gentle relationship that develops between the old man and the young woman be the catalyst that unwittingly exposes her double life as a prostitute? Also starring Ryo Kase as Akiko's boyfriend. The narrative unfolds at an unhurried pace, and is nicely complemented by Katsumi Yanagijima's ravishing, detail-packed cinematography and Reza Narimizadeh's naturalistic sound design. In Japanese with English subtitles. (Like Someone in Love). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Stay with Us.
programme.desc: Gad Elmaleh decides to leave New York and move back to Paris, to get baptized and become a Catholic. Despite his attempt to hide the truth from his Jewish family, Gad's parents discover their son's unconditional love for the Virgin Mary - and for them, it's a nightmare! Determined to bring Gad back to reason and to his Jewishness, they turn his conversion into a battlefield - as Gad tries to make them understand by any means necessary that his sincere beliefs do not change his identity and the love he has for his family. (Reste un peu). Komedijos.

programme.title: Carlos.
programme.desc: In Paris in 1970, Mohamed Buddha was killed when a bomb, suspected to have been planted by Mossad, exploded after he got into his car. A month later, Ilyich Ramirez Sanchez, a Venezuelan separatist, travels to Beirut and meets Wadi Haddad. Hadad is considering Sanchez's offer to lead operations in London, under the watchful eye of Andrea, an agent working from Paris. When asked for his code name, Sanchez answers "Carlos". (Carlos). [12+]. Kriminalai. Dramos. Trileriai.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights.
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival. (Wuthering Heights). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Tale of Cinema.
programme.desc: As the film begins, Sangwon, an aimless and indecisive college student on school holiday after final examinations, avoids walking together with his older brother by instead taking a side street, where he finds a former girlfriend, Yongsil, working at an optician's store. Unsure of his own emotional preparedness in rekindling the relationship, he decides to watch a play while waiting for her to complete her work shift, delaying the decision to meet her later in the evening. The final words of anguish in the play, uttered by a desperately ill child unable to be comforted by his mother, would later be echoed by Sangwon from the rooftop of his parents' apartment after his own failed act of despair. In the film's corollary chapter, Tongsu, a struggling, rootless, and inscrutable filmmaker who has become obsessed with a short film directed by his former classmate - and in particular, the devoted and obliging woman in the film - encounters the young actress in person and begins to ingratiate himself into her company, acting out his projected image of her by imitating gestures and revisiting locations from the film in an attempt to realize his own created image of her. (Tale of Cinema). Dramos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Veiksmo. Kriminalai. Trileriai.

programme.title: Viceroy's House.
programme.desc: Viceroy's House in Delhi was the home of the British rulers of India. After 300 years, that rule was coming to an end. For 6 months in 1947, Lord Mountbatten, great grandson of Queen Victoria, assumed the post of the last Viceroy, charged with handing India back to its people. The film's story unfolds within that great House. Upstairs lived Mountbatten together with his wife and daughter; downstairs lived their 500 Hindu, Muslim and Sikh servants. As the political elite - Nehru, Jinnah and Gandhi - converged on the House to wrangle over the birth of independent India, conflict erupted. A decision was taken to divide the country and create a new Muslim homeland: Pakistan. It was a decision whose consequences reverberate to this day. The film examines these events through the prism of a marriage - that of Dickie and Edwina Mountbatten, and a romance, that between a young Hindu servant, Jeet, and his intended Muslim bride, Aalia. The young lovers find themselves caught up in the seismic end of Empire, in conflict with the Mountbattens and with their own communities, but never ever giving up hope. (Viceroy's House). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Little Solange.
programme.desc: Solange is 13 years old. She is a very young teenager of today, full of life and curiosity for the future, with something special: she is sentimental to excess, and adores her parents. One day, his parents are arguing, getting angry, starting to drift apart – disagreement arises. As the shadow of divorce becomes clearer, Solange sees her world crack. So she will worry, react, suffer, in short still believe in it. This is the story of an overly tender young teenager who wants something impossible: that love never ends. (Petite Solange). Dramos.

programme.title: Ernest And Celestine.
programme.desc: Ernest & Celestine (French: Ernest et Célestine) is a 2012 Franco-Belgian animated comedy-drama film directed by Stéphane Aubier, Vincent Patar and Benjamin Renner. Celestine is a young mouse who lives in the underground world of rodents. At the orphanage where she lives, the caretaker known as the Gray One tells scary stories about the evil nature of the bears that live in the outside world, though Celestine doubts that they are entirely true. She loves to draw but must soon study dentistry, since that's what all rodents do, and to prepare, she must travel above ground to collect the lost teeth of bear cubs from underneath pillows. (Ernest et Célestine). Nuotykių.

programme.title: The Truth About Love.
programme.desc: As part of a drunken bet with her sister Felicity, happily married Alice sends an anonymous Valentine's card to her husband Sam to see if he hides it. When he does, what was a prank leads to a series of events and revelations that may put her marriage at risk, and leaves her looking for answers. (The Truth About Love). [16+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Pink Lady.
programme.desc: Battie and Lazer, a Jewish ultra-Orthodox couple are being blackmailed by the Wolf's gang. Both are going to fight the gang in a journey that will test their love and faith and change their lives forever. (Pink Lady). Dramos.

programme.title: The Green Perfume.
programme.desc: In the middle of a performance at la Comédie-Française, an actor dies on stage, poisoned. Martin, member of the troupe and friend of the victim, becomes the center of everyone's attention. Suspected by the police, he's also chased by a mysterious organization, Le Parfum vert, that seems to have ordered the murder. (Le Parfum vert). Komedijos. Mistika. Trileriai. Kriminalai.

programme.title: Wuthering Heights.
programme.desc: Writer-director Andrea Arnold's (Fish Tank, Red Road, American Honey) Film4-funded, radical adaptation (co-written by Olivia Hetreed) of Emily Brontë's classic romantic novel, starring Kaya Scodelario (Skins) as Cathy and James Howson (in his screen debut) as Heathcliffe. On a trip to Liverpool, Mr Earnshaw (Paul Hilton) offers a young black street-dweller, Heathcliffe (Solomon Glave), a chance to escape his poverty and come to live with him and his two children at his remote farm. He'll have to work, of course, but, despite the colour of his skin, he will be treated as equal. Well, that's the promise, and it's kept, but the Yorkshire moors were a tough place from which to eke an existence in the 19th century; and as for equality... he's not exactly immediately welcomed by his new 'siblings'. However, he does quickly bond with the young Cathy (Shannon Beer) and the two develop a passionate friendship, which only serves to stoke the ire of her brother Hindley (Lee Shaw). But, as the two grow, Cathy (Scodelario) and Heathcliffe (Howson) find themselves caught in a tempest of obsessive love, anger and revenge. Robbie Ryan's cinematography starkly captures the raw nature of those weather-beaten uplands - an effect further enhanced by the lack of a musical score. The film was nominated for Golden Lion at the 2011 Venice Film Festival. (Wuthering Heights). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: You Ain't Seen Nothin' Yet.
programme.desc: From beyond the grave, celebrated playwright Antoine d'Anthac gathers together all his friends who have appeared over the years in his play "Eurydice." These actors watch a recording of the work performed by a young acting company, La Compagnie de la Colombe. During the screening, Antoine's friends are so overwhelmed by their memories of the play that they start performing it together, despite no longer being the appropriate age for their various roles. (Vous n'avez encore rien vu). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: The Measure of a Man.
programme.desc: DI Dave Creegan is shot and, whilst unconscious, has a near-death experience that leaves him with the ability to sense criminals upon recovery. Joining the Organized and Serial Crime Unit with inspector Susan Taylor, Creegan learns from his friend Cyril, a self-proclaimed psychic, that two recently abducted boys have been murdered 'in the clouds'. In both cases, a daffodil has been left at the scene of the abduction, a fact reminiscent of similar crimes in Stuttgart some years earlier. A car at the last crime scene is traced to pharmaceutical chemist professor Ronald ... (La Loi du marché). Dramos.

programme.title: Rookie.
programme.desc: This is a story of lost dreams and second chances that is steeped in engine oil and the adrenaline of motorcycle racing. (Rookie). Veiksmo. Dramos.

programme.title: Brideshead Revisited.
programme.desc: Although he aspires to become an artist, middle-class Charles Ryder reads history at the University of Oxford, where he befriends the flamboyant and wealthy Lord Sebastian Flyte. Sebastian's mother, Lady Marchmain, strongly disapproves of Sebastian's lifestyle, especially his heavy drinking. When Sebastian takes Charles home to visit his nanny, Charles is enthralled by the grandeur of the Marchmain family estate, known as Brideshead, and he is entranced by its residents, including the devout Roman Catholic Lady Marchmain and her other children, Sebastian's elder brother Bridey and his sisters Julia and Cordelia. (Brideshead Revisited). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: That's What I Am.
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties." (That's What I Am). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: There's Only One Jimmy Grimble.
programme.desc: Jimmy Grimble (Lewis McKenzie (actor)) is a 15-year-old misfit living in Manchester, where nothing seems to go his way. Jimmy is constantly threatened by the school bully, "Gorgeous" Gordon (Bobby Power); he is also not sure what to make of Johnny (Ben Miller), a lost-in-the-ozone biker who is dating Donna (Gina McKee), Jimmy's mum; and he has a crush on one of his classmates, Sara (Samia Ghadie), who seems to like him, but his powers of speech fail him when he tries to talk to her. Like most Natives of Manchester, Jimmy loves football. He is a fervent supporter of Manchester City and attends home games with Donna's ex-boyfriend, Harry (Ray Winstone). Jimmy also loves to play football, but while Eric (Robert Carlyle), the coach of his school's team, thinks he has potential, "Gorgeous" is already a skilled player, and when Gordon's father informs the school he will make a large and much-needed donation if their team makes it to the Manchester Schools Cup final, it looks like Jimmy will be on the bench for a while. But when an old woman gives Jimmy a pair of boots that once belonged to one of City's greatest players, his skills on the field begin to change. (There's Only One Jimmy Grimble). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Like Someone In Love.
programme.desc: The veteran, multi-award-winning Iranian director Kiarostami Abbas chose Japan as the location for this intriguing drama, only the second feature he has made outside his homeland since his prolific career began in 1970. Rin Takanashi stars as Akiko, a young student in Tokyo who has turned to escort work to pay for her studies. Her latest job takes her to the city's suburbs, to the home of an elderly academic, Takashi (Tadashi Okuno). It transpires that he's more interested in companionship than sex, but will the gentle relationship that develops between the old man and the young woman be the catalyst that unwittingly exposes her double life as a prostitute? Also starring Ryo Kase as Akiko's boyfriend. The narrative unfolds at an unhurried pace, and is nicely complemented by Katsumi Yanagijima's ravishing, detail-packed cinematography and Reza Narimizadeh's naturalistic sound design. In Japanese with English subtitles. (Like Someone in Love). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Sisters.
programme.desc: For thirty years, three French-Algerian sisters have been hoping to find their brother who was abducted by their father, and hidden in newly decolonized Algeria. Their relationship is shaken when the eldest decides to write a play based on the traumatizing events of their childhood and they learn that their father is dying and decide to go to Algeria to seize their last opportunity to have him reveal where their brother is. (Soeurs). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Maestro(s).
programme.desc: At the Dumars, we are conductors from father to son: François is completing a long and brilliant international career while Denis has just won yet another Victory for Classical Music. When François learns that he has been chosen to lead La Scala, his ultimate dream, his holy grail, he cannot believe his ears. At first satisfied for his father, Denis is quickly disillusioned when he discovers that in reality it is he who has been chosen to go to Milan. (Maestro(s)). Dramos. Komedijos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Nezouh.
programme.desc: Even as bombs fall on Damascus, Mutaz refuses to flee to the uncertain life of a refugee. His wife, Hala, and daughter, Zeina, must make the choice whether to stay or leave. (Nezouh). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Levity.
programme.desc: Manual Jordan, a man who served nearly 23 years for killing a teenager during an attempted robbery, is released on parole in spite of his objections. After spending his time staring at a clipping of Abner Easley, the boy he killed, he returns to the city he used to live in to find redemption. He ends up living at a community house which is run by Miles Evans, a preacher. He offers Manual work so he can pay for the room, and Manual places Abner's photo in his room to remind himself of his crime. (Levity). [16+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Don't Come Knocking.
programme.desc: Shepard stars as Howard Spence, an aging, hard-living Western (genre) star, who, disgusted with his life & washed up, flees by horse from the set of his latest western filming in the desert outside Moab, Utah, Utah. He hits the road looking for refuge in his past, traveling to his hometown of Elko, Nevada, Nevada to visit his mother, who he hasn't seen in 30 years. And, eventually, to Butte, Montana, Montana, looking for a woman (Jessica Lange) he left behind twenty years before when he was filming a movie there. Also converging on Butte is a young woman named Sky (Sarah Polley), returning her late mother's ashes to her hometown and conducting a search of her own. (Don't Come Knocking). [12+]. Dramos. Muzikiniai.

programme.title: Memphis.
programme.desc: A strange singer with God-given talent drifts through his adopted city of Memphis with its canopy of ancient oak trees, streets of shattered windows, and aura of burning spirituality. Surrounded by beautiful women, legendary musicians, a stone-cold hustler, a righteous preacher, and a wolf pack of kids, the sweet, yet unstable, performer avoids the recording studio, driven by his own form of self-discovery. His journey quickly drags him from love and happiness right to the edge of another dimension. (Memphis). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Kriminalai. Veiksmo. Trileriai.

programme.title: Every Thing Will Be Fine.
programme.desc: Tomas Eldan is a novelist, living with Sara in a rural area of Quebec. Their relationship is strained, as she wants marriage and children while he just wants to focus on his writing. Tomas is driving home on a wintery rural road when a toboggan carrying brothers Christopher and Nicholas slides into the path of his vehicle, resulting in Nicholas' death but causing no physical damage to five-year-old Christopher. (Every Thing Will Be Fine). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom.
programme.desc: Biopic that sees Idris Elba play the South African lawyer who campaigned restlessly against apartheid in the 1940s before becoming one of the greatest leaders of the modern age. It chronicles Nelson Mandela's journey from childhood in a rural village, to prominent figure in a political movement striving for equality, to 27 years of imprisonment, and finally to his inauguration as South Africa's president. (Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Triumph Of Love.
programme.desc: Romantic comedy. Princess Aspasia falls in love with Agis. However, if he were to discover her true identity he would spurn her advances since his "father" has taught him to reject love. So, Aspasia dresses up as... Fokion and tries to seduce him. (The Triumph of Love). [16+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Outbound.
programme.desc: A drama about a woman who seems able to overcome everything for freedom, except for her past mistakes. (Periferic). Dramos. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

programme.title: Viceroy's House.
programme.desc: Viceroy's House in Delhi was the home of the British rulers of India. After 300 years, that rule was coming to an end. For 6 months in 1947, Lord Mountbatten, great grandson of Queen Victoria, assumed the post of the last Viceroy, charged with handing India back to its people. The film's story unfolds within that great House. Upstairs lived Mountbatten together with his wife and daughter; downstairs lived their 500 Hindu, Muslim and Sikh servants. As the political elite - Nehru, Jinnah and Gandhi - converged on the House to wrangle over the birth of independent India, conflict erupted. A decision was taken to divide the country and create a new Muslim homeland: Pakistan. It was a decision whose consequences reverberate to this day. The film examines these events through the prism of a marriage - that of Dickie and Edwina Mountbatten, and a romance, that between a young Hindu servant, Jeet, and his intended Muslim bride, Aalia. The young lovers find themselves caught up in the seismic end of Empire, in conflict with the Mountbattens and with their own communities, but never ever giving up hope. (Viceroy's House). [12+]. Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Little Solange.
programme.desc: Solange is 13 years old. She is a very young teenager of today, full of life and curiosity for the future, with something special: she is sentimental to excess, and adores her parents. One day, his parents are arguing, getting angry, starting to drift apart – disagreement arises. As the shadow of divorce becomes clearer, Solange sees her world crack. So she will worry, react, suffer, in short still believe in it. This is the story of an overly tender young teenager who wants something impossible: that love never ends. (Petite Solange). Dramos.

programme.title: In Our Prime.
programme.desc: When an outcast in a private school meets the school's security guard and asks him to teach him maths, their friendship is put at risk after an incident there. (Isanghan naraui suhakja). [18+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Souvenir.
programme.desc: Liliane (Isabelle Huppert) was once "Laura", a rising star in the singing world, who had her moment of glory when she finished second in the 1974 European Song Contest behind Abba. Today, everyone has forgotten her brush with fame, and she works in a pâté factory. But when she meets Jean (Kévin Azaïs), a 21-year-old aspiring boxer, her dreary life is suddenly turned upside down. He falls in love with her, and convinces her she should make a return to the stage. (Souvenir). [12+]. Romantiniai. Dramos.

programme.title: Madame Bovary.
programme.desc: Bored in her marriage to a country doctor and stifled by life in a small town, the restless Emma Bovary pursues her dreams of passion and excitement at any cost. (Madame Bovary). Dramos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: Conviction.
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell, Hilary Swank and Melissa Leo star in Tony Goldwyn's fact-based drama. When Kenny Waters (Rockwell) is jailed for murder, his elder sister Betty Anne (Swank) is incredulous. She knows that he has an unruly streak to his character and that his temper occasionally flares violently, but she's certain he's not capable of the brutal murder of an old woman. Nancy Taylor (Leo), the officer in charge of the case, sees things very differently and, despite there being only the slimmest of circumstantial evidence and hearsay to link Kenny to the murder, he is charged and subsequently found guilty. However, over the course of the following decade, advances in forensics and Betty Anne's transformation, through hard study, into a campaigning lawyer combine to offer Kenny hope. As long as the police kept all the evidence and records relating to his case... With Minnie Driver and Juliette Lewis. Film4 premiere. (Conviction). [16+]. Kriminalai. Dramos.

programme.title: Highway 65.
programme.desc: A promising police officer, Daphna, finds herself in a small town handling petty crimes, but the disappearance of a former beauty queen, Orly, raises questions no one seems interested in answering. (Highway 65). Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Stay with Us.
programme.desc: Gad Elmaleh decides to leave New York and move back to Paris, to get baptized and become a Catholic. Despite his attempt to hide the truth from his Jewish family, Gad's parents discover their son's unconditional love for the Virgin Mary - and for them, it's a nightmare! Determined to bring Gad back to reason and to his Jewishness, they turn his conversion into a battlefield - as Gad tries to make them understand by any means necessary that his sincere beliefs do not change his identity and the love he has for his family. (Reste un peu). Komedijos.

programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere. (Days of the Bagnold Summer). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos. Muzikiniai.

programme.desc: Hercue Poirot is travelling aboard the Orient Express from Istanbul to Paris. The next night the train is caught in heavy Balkan snow, and the following morning Ratchett is found stabbed to death. Railway executive Bianchi prevails upon Poirot to solve the case, and with the train fully booked, there are no shortage of suspects. (Murder on the Orient Express). [12+]. Kriminalai. Dramos. Mistika.

programme.title: Hunting and Gathering.
programme.desc: The film opens showing the day-to-day life of an elderly lady named Paulette. Paulette lives alone, dedicated to her animals, in particular her cats, and her garden. (Ensemble, c'est tout). Dramos. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: The Swindle.
programme.desc: Betty and Victor are scam artists; when Betty brings in Maurice, a treasurer of a multinational company who is due to transfer five million francs, Betty suspects that he plans to steal that money. (Rien ne va plus). [12+]. Trileriai. Kriminalai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Lorelei.
programme.desc: Wayland (Pablo Schreiber) has been in prison for 15 years for armed robbery. Upon his release, he returns to his blue-collar hometown and inadvertently reconnects with his high school girlfriend Dolores (Jena Malone), now a single mother struggling to support her three kids. Soon after their reunion, Wayland moves in with the chaotic family and becomes a reluctant yet much-needed father figure. Struggling to pay the bills, Wayland finds himself drawn back to his old ways as Dolores yearns for her pre-motherhood dream of living in Los Angeles. (Lorelei). Dramos.

programme.title: The Last Emperor.
programme.desc: In 1950, Puyi has been kept in custody for five years, since the Red Army captured him during the Soviet invasion of Manchuria. In the recently established People's Republic of China, Puyi arrives as a political prisoner and war criminal at the Fushun War Criminals Management Centre. Soon after his arrival, Puyi attempts suicide, but is quickly revived and told he must stand trial. (The Last Emperor). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Truth About Love.
programme.desc: As part of a drunken bet with her sister Felicity, happily married Alice sends an anonymous Valentine's card to her husband Sam to see if he hides it. When he does, what was a prank leads to a series of events and revelations that may put her marriage at risk, and leaves her looking for answers. (The Truth About Love). [16+]. Romantiniai. Komedijos.

programme.title: Tale of Cinema.
programme.desc: As the film begins, Sangwon, an aimless and indecisive college student on school holiday after final examinations, avoids walking together with his older brother by instead taking a side street, where he finds a former girlfriend, Yongsil, working at an optician's store. Unsure of his own emotional preparedness in rekindling the relationship, he decides to watch a play while waiting for her to complete her work shift, delaying the decision to meet her later in the evening. The final words of anguish in the play, uttered by a desperately ill child unable to be comforted by his mother, would later be echoed by Sangwon from the rooftop of his parents' apartment after his own failed act of despair. In the film's corollary chapter, Tongsu, a struggling, rootless, and inscrutable filmmaker who has become obsessed with a short film directed by his former classmate - and in particular, the devoted and obliging woman in the film - encounters the young actress in person and begins to ingratiate himself into her company, acting out his projected image of her by imitating gestures and revisiting locations from the film in an attempt to realize his own created image of her. (Tale of Cinema). Dramos.

programme.title: The Fishbowl.
programme.desc: As her cancer spreads, Noelia's ultimate decision is to return to her native Vieques, Puerto Rico, and claim her freedom to decide her own fate. She reunites with her friends and family, who are still dealing with the contamination of the U.S. Navy after 60 years of military practices. (La Pecera). [16+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Carlos.
programme.desc: In Paris in 1970, Mohamed Buddha was killed when a bomb, suspected to have been planted by Mossad, exploded after he got into his car. A month later, Ilyich Ramirez Sanchez, a Venezuelan separatist, travels to Beirut and meets Wadi Haddad. Hadad is considering Sanchez's offer to lead operations in London, under the watchful eye of Andrea, an agent working from Paris. When asked for his code name, Sanchez answers "Carlos". (Carlos). [12+]. Kriminalai. Trileriai. Dramos.

programme.title: Levity.
programme.desc: Manual Jordan, a man who served nearly 23 years for killing a teenager during an attempted robbery, is released on parole in spite of his objections. After spending his time staring at a clipping of Abner Easley, the boy he killed, he returns to the city he used to live in to find redemption. He ends up living at a community house which is run by Miles Evans, a preacher. He offers Manual work so he can pay for the room, and Manual places Abner's photo in his room to remind himself of his crime. (Levity). [16+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: The Butler.
programme.desc: The Butler (2013) is an American historical drama directed by Lee Daniels and starring Forest Whitaker and Oprah Winfrey. At the White House an elderly butler named Cecil Gaines is waiting for the newly inaugurated president Barack Obama. While waiting, the butler recounts his life story and all the former US presidents he served. A butler's job requires keeping what you heard to yourself and doing your job unnoticed. Serving eight presidents during his tenure, Cecil observed how American society was changing and even he has felt these changes. (The Butler). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: The Triumph Of Love.
programme.desc: Romantic comedy. Princess Aspasia falls in love with Agis. However, if he were to discover her true identity he would spurn her advances since his "father" has taught him to reject love. So, Aspasia dresses up as... Fokion and tries to seduce him. (The Triumph of Love). [16+]. Komedijos. Romantiniai.

programme.title: There's Only One Jimmy Grimble.
programme.desc: Jimmy Grimble (Lewis McKenzie (actor)) is a 15-year-old misfit living in Manchester, where nothing seems to go his way. Jimmy is constantly threatened by the school bully, "Gorgeous" Gordon (Bobby Power); he is also not sure what to make of Johnny (Ben Miller), a lost-in-the-ozone biker who is dating Donna (Gina McKee), Jimmy's mum; and he has a crush on one of his classmates, Sara (Samia Ghadie), who seems to like him, but his powers of speech fail him when he tries to talk to her. Like most Natives of Manchester, Jimmy loves football. He is a fervent supporter of Manchester City and attends home games with Donna's ex-boyfriend, Harry (Ray Winstone). Jimmy also loves to play football, but while Eric (Robert Carlyle), the coach of his school's team, thinks he has potential, "Gorgeous" is already a skilled player, and when Gordon's father informs the school he will make a large and much-needed donation if their team makes it to the Manchester Schools Cup final, it looks like Jimmy will be on the bench for a while. But when an old woman gives Jimmy a pair of boots that once belonged to one of City's greatest players, his skills on the field begin to change. (There's Only One Jimmy Grimble). [12+]. Dramos. Komedijos.

programme.title: Like Someone In Love.
programme.desc: The veteran, multi-award-winning Iranian director Kiarostami Abbas chose Japan as the location for this intriguing drama, only the second feature he has made outside his homeland since his prolific career began in 1970. Rin Takanashi stars as Akiko, a young student in Tokyo who has turned to escort work to pay for her studies. Her latest job takes her to the city's suburbs, to the home of an elderly academic, Takashi (Tadashi Okuno). It transpires that he's more interested in companionship than sex, but will the gentle relationship that develops between the old man and the young woman be the catalyst that unwittingly exposes her double life as a prostitute? Also starring Ryo Kase as Akiko's boyfriend. The narrative unfolds at an unhurried pace, and is nicely complemented by Katsumi Yanagijima's ravishing, detail-packed cinematography and Reza Narimizadeh's naturalistic sound design. In Japanese with English subtitles. (Like Someone in Love). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Sisters.
programme.desc: For thirty years, three French-Algerian sisters have been hoping to find their brother who was abducted by their father, and hidden in newly decolonized Algeria. Their relationship is shaken when the eldest decides to write a play based on the traumatizing events of their childhood and they learn that their father is dying and decide to go to Algeria to seize their last opportunity to have him reveal where their brother is. (Soeurs). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express.

During the journey, Poirot is approached by American businessman Ratchett, who unsuccessfully tries to hire the detective to expose the source of the death threats being made against him. The next night the train is caught in heavy Balkan snow, and the following morning Ratchett is found stabbed to death. Railway executive Bianchi prevails upon Poirot to solve the case, and with the train fully booked, there are no shortage of suspects. (Murder on the Orient Express). [12+]. Dramos. Mistika. programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again. (The Magic of Belle Isle). [12+]. Komedijos. Dramos.

programme.title: Costa Brava, Lebanon.
programme.desc: Members of a family who quit the polluted, rubbish-strewn city of Beirut for an idyllic mountain home. However, their dreams of a utopian existence are shattered by the construction of a landfill on the boundary of their land. (Costa Brava, Lebanon). Dramos.

programme.title: The Integrity Of Joseph Chambers.
programme.desc: Writer and director Robert Machoian's drama ponders the state of modern masculinity as a cack-handed insurance salesman played by Clayne Crawford heads solo to the woods for a fateful hunting trip. Joseph Chambers (Crawford) has moved his family to the depths of Alabama in search of a more wholesome life. Bent on proving - presumably to himself - that he's no city slicker, he decides to go hunt deer in a local wood. The wood belongs to his mate Doug (Carl Kennedy). In fact, so does the massive truck he's gonna drive to get there. Oh, and even the gun he's gonna shoot the deer with. His wife Tess (Jordana Brewster) isn't too happy about all this. She grew up in a hunting family, so none of this impresses her and she'd definitely do a better job of it than him. Anyway, when clueless Joseph goes stumbling round the woods with a loaded gun, will the result be anything good? Of course not, but just how not good is quite an eye-opener... Network Premiere. (The Integrity Of Joseph Chambers). Dramos.

programme.title: Ernest & Celestine (2012).
programme.desc: The story of an unlikely friendship between a bear, Ernest, and a young mouse named Celestine. (Ernest & Celestine).

programme.title: Conviction.
programme.desc: Sam Rockwell, Hilary Swank and Melissa Leo star in Tony Goldwyn's fact-based drama. When Kenny Waters (Rockwell) is jailed for murder, his elder sister Betty Anne (Swank) is incredulous. She knows that he has an unruly streak to his character and that his temper occasionally flares violently, but she's certain he's not capable of the brutal murder of an old woman. Nancy Taylor (Leo), the officer in charge of the case, sees things very differently and, despite there being only the slimmest of circumstantial evidence and hearsay to link Kenny to the murder, he is charged and subsequently found guilty. However, over the course of the following decade, advances in forensics and Betty Anne's transformation, through hard study, into a campaigning lawyer combine to offer Kenny hope. As long as the police kept all the evidence and records relating to his case... With Minnie Driver and Juliette Lewis. Film4 premiere. (Conviction). [16+]. Dramos. Kriminalai.

programme.title: The Lookout.
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere. (Le guetteur). Kriminalai. Trileriai. Veiksmo.

(Mandela: Long Walk to Freedom). [12+]. Dramos.

programme.title: I Was A Simple Man.
programme.desc: "I Was A Simple Man" is a ghost story set in the pastoral countryside of the north shore of O'ahu, Hawai'i. Revealed in four chapters, it tells the story of an elderly man facing the end of his life, visited by the ghosts of his past. Incorporating familial history and mythology, dream logic and surrealism, "I Was a Simple Man" is a time-shifting, kaleidoscopic story of a fractured family facing the death of their patriarch that will take us from the high-rises of contemporary Honolulu to pre-WWII pastorals of O'ahu and, finally, into the beyond. (I Was a Simple Man). [16+]. Dramos.

Soon after their reunion, Wayland moves in with the chaotic family and becomes a reluctant yet much-needed father figure. Struggling to pay the bills, Wayland finds himself drawn back to his old ways as Dolores yearns for her pre-motherhood dream of living in Los Angeles. (Lorelei). Dramos.
